metadata.short_title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate formation of trade unions, regulation and improvement of relations between employers and workmen.
repeals: The Punjab Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2010 (II of 2010)
metadata.max_penalty: five thousand rupees or imprisonment (implied by context of penalties section)
metadata.one_line: Regulates trade union formation and industrial relations in Punjab, establishing courts and tribunals for dispute resolution.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation of trade unions and improves relations between employers and workmen in the Punjab. It establishes mechanisms for collective bargaining, strike/lock-out procedures, and the resolution of industrial disputes through Labour Courts and Tribunals. The Act also defines unfair labour practices and sets penalties for offences related to industrial relations.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Labour Code, 2026
metadata.long_title: An Act to consolidate, simplify and rationalise the laws relating to rights of the workers...
amends: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act 2019
repeals: The Factories Act, 1934
The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act 2019
metadata.max_penalty: fines or forfeiture
metadata.one_line: Consolidates and simplifies laws relating to workers' rights, safety, trade unions, and compensation in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and simplifies laws regarding workers' rights, employment agreements, and occupational safety in Punjab. It defines key terms like 'worker' and 'employer', prohibits forced labour, regulates working hours, and establishes duties for employers and workers to ensure safety. The Code also governs trade union registration, collective bargaining, the right to strike, and provides compensation for work-related injuries or death.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Maternity Benefit Ordinance, 1958
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to consolidate the law relating to employment of women in establishments in the Punjab.
establishes: Inspector of Factories (for purposes of this Ordinance)
metadata.max_penalty: fine which may extend to two hundred and fifty rupees
metadata.administering_body: Labour Welfare Directorate of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: Consolidates laws regarding maternity benefits and employment restrictions for women in establishments in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law relating to the employment of women in establishments within the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'maternity benefit', 'employer', and 'Establishment', and restricts women from working during specific periods surrounding childbirth. The document outlines procedures for payment, employer liabilities, penalties for contravention, and the role of the Inspector of Factories.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Minimum Wages Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to consolidate the laws regulating minimum rates of wages for workers of various categories.
repeals: The Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 (XXXIX of 1961)
the West Pakistan Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969 (XX of 1969)
the Employees Cost of Living Allowance (Relief) Act, 1973 (I of 1974)
the Punjab Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1988 (II of 1989)
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with a fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees or with both
metadata.one_line: Consolidates laws regulating minimum wages for workers in industrial and commercial establishments in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates existing laws regarding minimum rates of wages for unskilled and skilled workers in Punjab. It establishes a Minimum Wages Board to recommend and declare minimum wage rates for various industries and establishments. The Act defines key terms such as 'adult', 'adolescent', and 'commercial establishment' and outlines penalties for employers who pay wages below the prescribed minimum rates.

name: PUNJAB OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for occupational safety and health at workplace.
establishes: Punjab Council of Occupational Safety and Health
metadata.max_penalty: fine which may extend to rupees two hundred thousand
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for occupational safety and health at workplaces in Punjab, defining duties and establishing a safety council.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2019 consolidates laws to protect persons at workplaces from occupational hazards. It outlines specific duties for employers, employees, self-employed persons, and those controlling premises. The Act establishes the Punjab Council of Occupational Safety and Health to oversee safety functions and creates offences with penalties up to two hundred thousand rupees for contraventions.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the prohibition of child labour and regulation of labour at the brick kilns in the Punjab.
metadata.max_penalty: simple imprisonment up to six months and fine up to five hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Act prohibits child labour and regulates labor conditions at brick kilns in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016 aims to protect children from hazardous work environments at brick kilns. It mandates written contracts for workers, limits cash advances (peshgi) to fifty thousand rupees, and strictly prohibits employing children under fourteen years of age. The Act empowers inspectors to seal kilns, investigate violations, and imposes severe penalties on occupiers and guardians who contravene these provisions.

name: PUNJAB RESTRICTION ON EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to prohibit the employment of children and to restrict the employment of adolescents in certain occupations and processes.
repeals: The Employment of Children Act, 1991 (V of 1991)
The Punjab Restriction on Employment of Children Ordinance, 2016 (XIII of 2016)
metadata.one_line: Prohibits child employment and restricts adolescent hazardous work in Punjab, repealing the 1991 Act.
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children under fifteen years and restricts adolescents (15-18 years) from hazardous occupations. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on eradication measures and sets strict limits on working hours, rest intervals, and weekly holidays for adolescents. The legislation also outlines penalties for violations, defines hazardous works in the Schedule, and repeals the previous Employment of Children Act, 1991.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Weights and Measures Ordinance, 1965
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to consolidate the law regulating the use of weights and measures in the Province of [the Punjab].
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of [the Punjab], except the Tribal Areas
metadata.commencement: Part I at once; Parts II, III and V on such date as Government may notify; Part IV on expiry of three months from the date Parts II, III and V come into force in that area
repeals: The Sind Weights and Measures Act, 1932
The Bombay Weights and Measures Act, 1932, as applicable to Karachi
The Punjab Weights and Measures Act, 1941
The Bahawalpur State Weights and Measures Act, 1946
The North-West Frontier Province Weights and Measures Act, 1947
metadata.max_penalty: fine which may extend to one thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Consolidates laws regulating weights and measures in Punjab, establishing standards, licensing, verification, and penalties.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates the law regarding weights and measures in the Province of Punjab. It establishes secondary and working standards, requires licensing for manufacturing, and mandates verification and stamping of instruments. The document defines various terms related to measurement and sets out penalties for fraudulent use or possession of unauthorized weights and measures.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Punjab Workers Welfare Fund.
repeals: The Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971 (XXXVI of 1971)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund and outlines contribution, recovery, and governing body procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund to facilitate workers in the Province of Punjab. It mandates establishments with a total income above five hundred thousand rupees to contribute two percent of their income to the Fund. The Act defines the constitution of the Governing Body, outlines modes of payment and recovery through the Employees' Social Security Institution, and provides for exemptions from taxes. It also repeals the Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab General Clauses Act, 1956
metadata.long_title: An Act to facilitate the interpretations of [the Punjab] Acts and to shorten the language used therein.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Punjab, except the Tribal Areas
repeals: The Sind General Clauses Act, 1947
The Punjab General Clauses Act, 1898
The Punjab General Clauses Act, 1898, as applicable to the Districts of Bahawalnagar, Bahawalpur and Rahimyar Khan
The North-West Frontier Province General Clauses Act, 1932
metadata.one_line: An Act to facilitate the interpretation of Punjab Acts and shorten the language used therein.
metadata.summary: This Act provides general rules for the construction of enactments passed by the Provincial Legislature of Punjab. It defines key legal terms such as 'abet', 'act', and 'British India' to ensure consistent interpretation across various laws. The Act also establishes procedures for making orders, computing time, and citing other enactments, while repealing previous General Clauses Acts applicable to Punjab and specific districts.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Judicial Academy Act, 2007
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Judicial Academy in the Province of the Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Judicial Academy Ordinance 2007 (XV of 2007)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Judicial Academy to train judicial officers and court personnel in the Province of Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Judicial Academy as a body corporate within the Province of Punjab. The Academy is tasked with imparting pre-service and in-service training to judicial officers and court personnel, developing skills for court management, and promoting ethical standards. It functions under the management of a Board of Management and operates from a main campus at Kala Shah Kaku, with provisions for sub-campuses.

name: PUNJAB PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for appointment, salary, allowances and privileges of Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab.
metadata.one_line: Provides for the appointment, salary, allowances, and privileges of Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the appointment, term of office, salary, and various allowances for Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Assembly' and 'Government' and outlines entitlements including official residence, transport, medical facilities, and leave. The document also grants power to the Government to make rules for carrying out its purposes.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1974

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for salaries, allowances and privileges of Members of the Provincial Assembly of the Province of the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: at once, but deemed to have taken effect on and from the 1st day of October, 1974
repeals: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Order, 1972 (Punjab Order No.1 of 1972)
The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Ordinance, 1974 (Punjab Ordinance No. XII of 1974)
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for salaries, allowances, and privileges for members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for salaries, allowances, and privileges for Members of the Provincial Assembly of the Province of the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'Member', 'Assembly', and 'session' to clarify eligibility and scope. The legislation outlines specific financial entitlements including salary rates, daily allowances, travelling expenses, medical facilities, and exemptions from toll taxes. Additionally, it empowers the Finance Committee to make rules necessary to carry out the purposes of the Act.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the salary, allowances and privileges of the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: at once, but deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of March, 1975
repeals: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1972
Punjab Ordinance No. XVI of 1975
metadata.administering_body: Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the financial terms and official privileges for the Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It defines specific entitlements including monthly salary, various allowances, transport facilities, an official residence, and medical benefits. The legislation also outlines procedures for claiming expenses upon taking up or laying down office and repeals previous orders and ordinances regarding these matters.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY SPEAKER (SALARY, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the salary, allowances and privileges of the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: at once but deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of March, 1975
repeals: The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Order, 1972
Punjab Ordinance No. XV of 1975
metadata.administering_body: Finance Committee of Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for the salary, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the financial terms and official privileges for the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. It defines specific amounts for salary, sumptuary allowance, transport, and residence, while also outlining perks for former Speakers. The Finance Committee is empowered to make rules under this Act and approve additional perks.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC DEFENDERS SERVICE ACT 2007 (REPEAL) ACT 2012

metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to restrict the number of goats in the Province of Punjab. It grants the Provincial Government powers to regulate grazing, keeping, movement, and slaughter of goats through notifications and rules. The law establishes penalties for contravention, including imprisonment, fines, and forfeiture of the goat, while providing for summary trial and arrest by empowered officers.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Halal Development Agency Act, 2016

It defines key terms such as 'food', 'halal', and 'Inspection Body' while outlining the Agency's functions, powers to issue certificates, and authority over logos. The Act also provides for the Agency's financial management, audit requirements, and protection for actions taken in good faith.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS AND LIVESTOCK ASSOCIATIONS UNION (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for registering and controlling village livestock associations and their unions in the Province of Punjab. It defines the qualifications for membership, limits member liability to their share capital, and outlines the powers of the registration authority regarding incorporation and bye-law amendments. The document also sets up mechanisms for resolving disputes between members or between associations and grants the Government power to make rules.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Livestock Breeding Act, 2014
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate the livestock breeding services in the Punjab.

metadata.summary: This Act regulates livestock breeding services within the Punjab to improve genetic potential and protect indigenous breeds. It establishes the Livestock Breeding Services Authority, defines various technical terms like artificial insemination and herd books, and sets strict standards for facilities and personnel. The legislation mandates registration for businesses and individuals, outlines licensing procedures, and prescribes penalties for conducting business without proper authorization.

name: PUNJAB LIVESTOCK, DAIRY AND POULTRY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 1974

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Livestock, Dairy and Poultry Development Board as a body corporate within the Province of Punjab. The Board is empowered to establish, manage, control, and run various livestock, dairy, poultry, and allied projects in the public sector. It defines the constitution of the Board, including its Directors and Managing Director, and outlines its powers regarding funds, accounts, rules, and regulations.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to regulate the production and marketing of milk and milk products in the Punjab.

metadata.summary: The Punjab Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963 was promulgated by the Governor of West Pakistan to regulate the production and marketing of milk and milk products in the Punjab. It establishes a body corporate known as the Milk Board with powers to acquire property, sue, and be sued. The Ordinance defines key terms such as 'milk', 'milch animals', and 'producer', and outlines the constitution, functions, and financial management of the Board.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Poultry Production Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate poultry production activities in the Punjab.
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months but which shall not be less than seven days and with fine which may extend to five hundred thousand rupees but which shall not be less than one hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Act regulates poultry production in Punjab through registration, biosecurity, and penalty mechanisms.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Poultry Production Act, 2016 was enacted to regulate poultry production activities within the province. It mandates the registration of poultry premises to improve product quality and ensure biosecurity measures are followed. The Act establishes a Registration Committee and an Appellate Board to handle applications and appeals regarding registration status.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in [the Punjab].
metadata.territorial_extent: the graveyard known as the Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore, and any other graveyard in [the Punjab] to which provisions are extended by notification.
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for the preservation and maintenance of graveyards in Punjab, establishing a Committee and Tribunal to manage encroachments.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Graveyards (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958 establishes a framework for preserving and maintaining specific graveyards in Punjab. It creates a Committee and a Tribunal with powers under the Civil Procedure Code, 1908, to investigate encroachments, define graveyard limits, and manage compensation. The Government appoints the Committee, which functions as a body corporate, while local authorities may be required to contribute funds for maintenance.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Khal Panchayat (Repeal) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Punjab Khal Panchayat Act 2019.
repeals: The Punjab Khal Panchayat Act, 2019
metadata.one_line: Repeals the Punjab Khal Panchayat Act 2019 and transfers its properties and employees to provincial departments.
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Khal Panchayat Act 2019 effective immediately. It mandates the transfer of all available properties from the defunct Punjab Khal Panchayat Authority to the Irrigation Department. Additionally, it outlines the absorption or termination of existing employees and the transfer of pension funds to relevant provincial departments.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the constitution, functioning, elections, finance and properties of local governments in the Province of Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Local Government Act, 1979
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes the structure, functions, elections, finance and properties of local governments in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2022 provides for the constitution, functioning, and authority of local governments including Metropolitan Corporations, District Councils, and Union Councils. It outlines the demarcation of areas, election procedures, qualifications for office, financial management, and property administration. The Act also establishes a Local Government Finance Commission to oversee fiscal transfers and ensures the transition from previous authorities.

name: PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS (DISSOLUTION) (EXTENSION OF LIMITATION) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government Institutions (Dissolution) (Extension of Limitation) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for extension of limitation in certain matters relating to Union Councils.
metadata.one_line: Extends limitation periods for acts related to Union Councils dissolved under Martial Law in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the extension of limitation periods in matters relating to Union Councils within the Province of Punjab. It applies specifically where acts or things required by law could not be done due to the dissolution of Union Councils pursuant to a Martial Law Order. The period during which such actions could not be performed is excluded from computing the statutory time limit for those acts.

name: PUNJAB MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) (REPEAL) ACT 2006

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) (Repeal) Act, 2006

metadata.status_evidence: It shall come into force at once. The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003 (Act No.V of 2003) is hereby repealed.
metadata.one_line: This Act repeals the Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003.
metadata.summary: This legislation serves to repeal the Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003. It ensures that previous legal operations, actions taken, orders issued, and penalties awarded under the repealed Act remain unaffected by this repeal. The Act came into force immediately upon its promulgation.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF EXPRESSINIG MATTERS ON WALLS ACT, 1995

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Prohibition of Expressing Matters on Walls Act, 1995
metadata.long_title: An Act to prohibit expression of matters on walls in the Punjab.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of the Punjab
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine not less than twenty five thousand rupees or more than one hundred thousand rupees or with both
metadata.one_line: Prohibits expressing matters on walls in Punjab and prescribes penalties for violations.
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the affixing of posters, bills, notices, or writing on walls in the Punjab with the intention to attract public attention. It establishes that such acts are punishable by imprisonment up to six months, a fine between twenty-five thousand and one hundred thousand rupees, or both, unless the wall owner expresses matters relating to themselves or their business. The Act empowers Local Councils to remove prohibited expressions within thirty days of commencement and allows for summary trials by Magistrates of the first class.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying Ordinance, 2001

metadata.one_line: This Ordinance prohibits kite flying in Punjab to save human life and protect property.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to prohibit kite flying activities that endanger human life or property. It defines specific terms such as 'kite flying' and 'sharp maanjha', establishes prohibitions on manufacturing, selling, or using kites with dangerous materials, and prescribes severe criminal penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations. The law also grants authorities powers of entry, search, seizure, and arrest without a warrant to enforce these provisions.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act for establishing the Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority.

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority to establish, manage, and regulate model cemeteries, graveyards, and crematoriums in the Punjab. The Authority is empowered to provide cemetery, funeral, crematory, transfer, and other related services to the public. It defines the composition of the Authority, its functions, powers, financial management, and audit procedures while repealing the previous Ordinance from 2017.

name: PUNJAB SUSPENSION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ORDINANCE 1999

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Suspension of Local Councils Ordinance, 1999
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the suspension of the Local Council constituted under the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 1979 (VI of 1979).
metadata.one_line: Suspends Local Councils in Punjab and vests their powers with appointed Administrators.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the immediate suspension of all Local Councils constituted under the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979. Upon commencement, all members of these councils are suspended, and office bearers cease to hold office. The powers and functions of the suspended councils are transferred to persons or authorities appointed by the Government as Administrators, while funds and property vest in the Government.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Timber Market (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a timber market within the revenue estates of Jia Musa and Chak Jia Musa. It validates actions taken under previous Martial Law Orders and West Pakistan Ordinances that were later declared invalid by the Supreme Court. The Lahore Improvement Trust is empowered to layout the market, allot sites to merchants, determine prices, and manage land acquisition and compensation.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish a Corporation for the purpose of promoting mineral development in the Province of the Punjab.

It outlines the financial structure, including the Corporation Fund and audit requirements, while granting the Government powers to remove directors or suspend resolutions. The Act also details the winding-up process and explicitly repeals the West Pakistan Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1958.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of sand leases within specific restricted areas in the Province of Punjab. It grants the Government power to terminate existing leases via official notification without court intervention. The document outlines mechanisms for offering alternative leases, refunding unutilized lease money, and compensating for infrastructure like roads or buildings. It also establishes penalties for contravention and defines terms such as 'Restricted area' and 'Authority'.

metadata.summary: The Punjab Minor Mineral (Cancellation of Leases) Act, 1977 was enacted to cancel specific mining leases of minor minerals granted by authorities other than the Deputy Commissioner. It applies to the Province of the Punjab and comes into force immediately upon enactment. The Act provides a mechanism for the Government to pay compensation to lessees for roads and buildings constructed for mining operations and establishes that decisions regarding compensation are final and conclusive.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Information Technology Board Ordinance, 1999

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Information Technology Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the Board's constitution, including the appointment of members by the Government and the designation of a President and Chairman. The document grants the Board powers to administer information technology, manage its fund, employ staff, and make rules and regulations, while also providing for budget approval and audit procedures.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2019

metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in development projects within the Province of Punjab. It establishes institutional arrangements including a Board, an Authority, and a Risk Management Unit to manage PPP projects. The legislation outlines the entire project delivery process from identification and approval to bidding, agreement negotiation, implementation, and termination, while also defining key terms and repealing previous related acts.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ACT 2010

metadata.repealed_by: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2014 (IX of 2014)
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes a framework for public-private partnerships to develop infrastructure in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Act, 2010 creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development within the province. It defines various PPP models such as Build-Operate-Transfer and Management Contracts, establishing institutional arrangements like a Steering Committee and Risk Management Unit. The Act outlines the project delivery process from identification to termination and includes provisions for dispute resolution and public disclosure.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Act, 2015

It repeals the previous Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970, and supersedes an earlier Ordinance passed in 2015.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Hepatitis Act, 2018

metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Province of Punjab. The legislation imposes strict responsibilities on healthcare facilities regarding waste disposal, safe blood transfusions, and the use of auto-disabled syringes, while also mandating testing for specific groups like prisoners and pregnant women.

name: PUNJAB INFECTIOUS DISEASES (PREVENTION AND CONTROL) ACT 2020

It empowers the Secretary, with Chief Minister's approval, to impose duties on medical practitioners, restrict gatherings, and manage potentially infectious persons. The Act defines key terms such as 'potentially infectious person' and outlines offences for non-compliance, repealing the previous Punjab Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004

The Act also outlines the composition of the Board of Directors, the establishment of a Fund, and provisions for rules and regulations.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2018

It transfers management of low-performing public schools from the Punjab Education Foundation to the new Authority and provides for the Authority's composition, functions, funding, and administrative rules.

It operates under the Government of the Punjab with a specific composition including members from the Provincial Assembly, education departments, and private sectors.

name: PUNJAB FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION ACT 2014
