It establishes a specific Fund for the Authority derived from government grants, loans, and other sources, while mandating proper accounting and annual audits by the Auditor General of Pakistan. The legislation also inserts new sections regarding the preparation of budgets and the submission of annual statements of accounts.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for promotion of Public Private Partnerships in Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2019
metadata.one_line: This Act promotes public private partnerships in Punjab by establishing an authority and regulating bidding processes.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Public Private Partnership Act, 2025 aims to encourage private sector participation in projects of public importance within the province. It establishes the Punjab Public Private Partnership Authority and an associated fund to manage these initiatives. The Act defines key terms related to bidding, concessions, and consortiums, while repealing the previous 2019 Act and ensuring continuity for existing contracts and employees.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish the Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority to construct, monitor, and regulate Sahulat Bazaars in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Sahulat Bazaars Authority to launch, construct, monitor, and maintain Sahulat Bazaars across the Punjab province. The Authority is empowered to supply essential commodities at notified rates and create business opportunities for entrepreneurs. It defines the composition of the Authority, its powers regarding land acquisition and infrastructure maintenance, and outlines procedures for framing regulations and rules.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Spatial Planning Authority Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish the Punjab Spatial Planning Authority.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Spatial Planning Authority to regulate land use and ensure sustainable development in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Spatial Planning Authority to ensure balanced growth and sustainable development through master and spatial planning. The Authority is empowered to approve plans, frame regulations, and harmonize laws regarding land use across the province. It defines key terms such as 'master plan', 'zoning', and 'Provincial Spatial Strategy' to guide urban and rural development while accommodating local variations.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Thalassemia Prevention Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to make provisions for the control and prevention of Thalassemia and other genetic disorders.
metadata.administering_body: Specialized Healthcare and Medical Education Department
metadata.one_line: Establishes an Advisory Council to prevent Thalassemia through genetic counseling, testing regulation, and early diagnosis in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an Advisory Council to manage the prevention and control of Thalassemia and other genetic disorders within the Punjab. The Council is responsible for facilitating early diagnosis, regulating laboratory accreditation, providing genetic counseling to carriers, and managing a data bank for policy making. It empowers the Government to make rules and the Council to frame regulations necessary for carrying out the Act's purposes.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2025

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act 2018.
amends: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
key_definitions: the Act (referring to the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act 2018)
metadata.administering_body: Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2018 Act regarding employee repatriation options and expanding study fields.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018 to address specific administrative changes. It grants employees transferred under a previous subsection a one-time option for repatriation to their parent departments at original seniority. Additionally, it expands the scope of study fields in Section 4 to include engineering, sciences, management, and related fields.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Specialized Medical Institutions Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to improve medical education, responsiveness and quality of clinical care for patients in an effective, efficient and accountable manner: for It is necessary to improve medical education, responsiveness and quality of clinical care patients and enhance healthcare services in Specialized Medical Institutions in an effective, efficient, responsive and transparent manner, and for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes Specialized Medical Institutions in Punjab to improve medical education and clinical care quality.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Specialized Medical Institutions Act, 2025 was enacted to enhance medical education, responsiveness, and the quality of clinical care within specialized institutions in the province. It empowers the Government of the Punjab to notify specific colleges or hospitals as Specialized Medical Institutions, which are established as bodies corporate with perpetual succession. The Act creates a Board of Governors comprising government secretaries, deans, and private sector eminences to administer these institutions, manage their finances, and oversee medical education and research functions.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.
metadata.parent_law: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Home Department
metadata.one_line: Amends Section 144 of the CrPC 1898 to replace Zila Nazim with Deputy Commissioner or Secretary.
metadata.summary: This Act amends Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 applicable in Punjab. It substitutes references to 'Zila Nazim' with 'Deputy Commissioner or Secretary to the Government of the Punjab, Home Department'. The amendment also omits specific recommendations regarding police superintendents and limits the duration of orders made under this section to thirty or ninety days, depending on the authority.

name: INSTITUTE OF SOUTHERN PUNJAB MULTAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Institute of Southern Punjab Multan (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010.
amends: The Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010
key_definitions: University (means the University of Southern Punjab established under this Act)
Institute (substituted by University except in specific clauses)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010 to rename it as the University of Southern Punjab and expand its jurisdiction.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Institute of Southern Punjab Multan Act, 2010 to officially rename the institution as the University of Southern Punjab. It expands the university's jurisdiction to cover the entire Province of Punjab while restricting the opening of sub-campuses or affiliations for ten years. The amendment also updates the long title, preamble, and various sections to reflect the new status, lists specific faculties in the schedule, and allows for diverse teaching methods including online and distance learning.

metadata.short_title: Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Police Order, 2002.
metadata.parent_law: Police Order, 2002
metadata.one_line: Amends Police Order 2002 to establish Organized Crime Units in every District for specific serious crimes.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 to establish an Organized Crime Unit in every District within the Province of Punjab. The units are headed by senior police officers and empowered to investigate specific categories of serious offenses including kidnapping for ransom, extortion, dacoity, robbery, theft of motor vehicles, and human trafficking. Special investigation teams may be constituted by the head of these units to handle different case categories.

metadata.short_title: The Police Order (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Police Order, 2002.
repeals: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (II of 2024)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Police Order 2002 to establish Organized Crime Units in every District and repeals a 2023 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 by inserting Article 18B to establish an Organized Crime Unit in every District of Punjab. The units are headed by senior police officers and empowered to investigate specific serious crimes including kidnapping for ransom, extortion, dacoity, robbery, trafficking of narcotic drugs, and inter-provincial gangs. The Act also repeals Rule 21.35 of the Police Rules, 1934 and supersedes the Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2023.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Laws (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the laws relating to Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.administering_body: Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat
metadata.one_line: Amends two specific Acts to update titles and streamline the working of the Assembly Secretariat.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972, and the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019. It substitutes references to 'Secretary' with 'Secretary General' in various sections and subsections of both Acts. Additionally, it defines the status of the Secretary General and establishes a separate Secretariat headed by this officer.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act 1997.
amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to include livestock income and introduce a super tax.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to expand the definition of taxable income to include livestock. It introduces a new 'super tax' for high-earning persons and modifies various sections regarding taxpayer definitions, assessment procedures, and penalty structures. The amendments also update terminology from 'assessee' to 'taxpayer' and replace fixed schedules with rules prescribed by the Government.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
key_definitions: the Act (referring to the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2018 Authority Act regarding tenure, meeting procedures, and administrator appointment.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to address immediate circumstances while the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It inserts a new subsection regarding the tenure of the Chairperson and members, substitutes provisions concerning meeting convening and presiding officers, omits section 5, and modifies rules for administrator appointment upon term expiry. The Ordinance comes into force immediately upon promulgation by the Governor.

name: PUNJAB AGRICULTURE MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018.
amends: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
repeals: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
key_definitions: the Act (referring to the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2018 Authority Act regarding tenure, meetings, and omits section 5 while repealing a 2023 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act 2018 to alter provisions concerning the tenure of the Chairperson and members, meeting convening procedures, and presiding officers. It substitutes specific subsections in sections 4 and 15B of the parent Act and omits section 5 entirely. Additionally, the Act repeals the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2023, deeming actions under the repealed Ordinance to be valid under this new Act.

name: PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (REPEAL AND RE-ORGANIZATION) ACT 2025

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Repeal and Re-organization) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993. It is necessary to repeal the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 (I of 1993) and dissolve the Cooperatives Board established thereunder; and vest all the properties, including movable and immovable, under the control of and vested in the Cooperatives Board, to the Government under the supervision of the Board of Revenue and for the matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto.
repeals: Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
metadata.one_line: Repeals the 1993 Dissolution Act, dissolves the Cooperatives Board, and vests its properties in the Government.
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 and dissolves the Cooperatives Board established under that repealed law. Upon commencement, all movable and immovable properties of the dissolved Board vest in the Government of the Punjab under the supervision of the Board of Revenue. The Act establishes a Liquidation Tribunal to handle pending proceedings and claims related to undesirable cooperative societies, ensuring that government liabilities are satisfied from the transferred property pool.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974.
repeals: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (XIX of 2023)
The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 (I of 2024)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and repeal related Ordinances.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to incorporate provisions for a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme. It inserts new definitions regarding pension schemes and modifies sections concerning retirement benefits and service qualifications. The Act also repeals two specific Ordinances from 2023 that previously amended the civil servants act.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to introduce a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and adjust retirement benefits.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to incorporate a new Defined Contribution Pension Scheme for civil servants appointed after its commencement. It modifies provisions regarding pension eligibility, gratuity calculation, and compassionate allowances for dismissed or removed servants. The document also establishes rules for provisional pension payments in cases of delayed determination and outlines contribution requirements for both the government and employees.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Defamation Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to make provisions in respect of defamation and for matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
repeals: Defamation Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Establishes a Tribunal to adjudicate defamation claims on social media and other platforms in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal provisions for addressing defamation through a specialized Tribunal within the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'defamation', 'social media', and 'Constitutional Office' to clarify the scope of protection. The legislation allows for the award of damages, mandatory apologies, and the suspension or blocking of social media accounts in cases of proven defamation. It applies to all forms of publication including electronic media and explicitly excludes the application of the Qanun-o-Shahadat.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to levy, alter and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: on the first day of July 2024 except section 4 which shall come into force on such date as the Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify
amends: The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
The Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967
The Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012
metadata.one_line: An Act to levy, alter and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends existing laws to levy, alter, and rationalize various taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It specifically updates court fees schedules, revises motor vehicle registration charges and tax rates, adjusts excise duties on minerals, and omits specific subsections from the Sales Tax on Services Act. The provisions generally come into force on July 1, 2024, with some exceptions subject to government notification.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010.
repeals: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010 regarding commissioner tenure and resignation.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010 to modify provisions concerning the Commissioner's tenure and resignation procedures. It inserts a new subsection stating that the Commissioner serves during the pleasure of the Government and adds 'removed' as an option alongside 'resigned'. The Act repeals the Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance 2023 and comes into force immediately upon assent by the Governor.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010 to allow government removal of the Commissioner without reason.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act 2010 to empower the Government to remove the Commissioner at any time before their term expires without assigning a reason. It also inserts language into section 6 regarding the insertion of 'I removed' alongside resignation clauses. The Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB PRICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for price control of essential commodities in the Punjab.
metadata.one_line: This Ordinance establishes a mechanism to fix prices and control the supply of essential commodities in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides an effective mechanism for fixing prices and controlling artificial price hikes of essential commodities in the Punjab. It empowers the Price Control Council and authorized officers to regulate production, movement, and sale of listed items like food grains, milk, and fuel. The law applies to dealers, producers, and importers, requiring them to maintain records and mark prices on goods.

name: PUNJAB REVISION OF SALARIES OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Revision of Salaries of Public Representatives Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to revise the salaries of the holders of public representative offices of Province of the Punjab.
amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
The Punjab Provincial Assembly Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
The Punjab Provincial Assembly Deputy Speaker (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
The Punjab Parliamentary Secretaries (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
The Punjab Special Assistants (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
The Punjab Advisors (Salary, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Revises salaries for public representatives in Punjab and amends related salary acts.
metadata.summary: This Act revises the salaries of holders of public representative offices in the Province of the Punjab. It amends seven existing laws, including Acts from 1974 and 1975, and Ordinances from 2002, to update specific salary figures and allow for future increases by government notification. The Act received assent from the Governor on December 19, 2024, and came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Enforcement and Regulation Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for establishment of the Punjab Enforcement and Regulatory Authority and to prescribe procedures for efficient and effective implementation and enforcement of special laws throughout Punjab.
metadata.commencement: on such date and apply to such area as the Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify
metadata.one_line: Establishes an overarching enforcement authority in Punjab to streamline regulatory compliance and enforce special laws.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Enforcement and Regulatory Authority to oversee the implementation of special laws across the province. It aims to improve coordination between existing agencies, designate lead regulators, and empower authorized officers to conduct hearings and administrative actions. The Act defines various terms related to enforcement, state property, and offences, while also granting powers to frame rules and regulations.

name: PUNJAB RICE CONTROL OF ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES ACT 2024

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for price control of essential commodities in the Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Ordinance 2023 (V of 2024)
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes a mechanism for price control and equitable distribution of essential commodities in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Price Control of Essential Commodities Act, 2024 provides an effective mechanism to fix prices and control artificial hikes of essential commodities in the Punjab. It empowers the Price Control Council and authorized officers to regulate production, movement, supply, and sale of listed items like food grains, milk, and medicines. The Act allows for the issuance of orders to ensure fair pricing and equitable distribution while defining key terms such as 'dealer' and 'essential commodity'. It repeals the previous Ordinance from 2023 and comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.short_title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Registration Act, 1908 to include overseas persons in registration office clauses.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 by modifying section 38. The amendment inserts a new clause allowing for the inclusion of a person who is overseas in the list of entities related to a registration-office.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Saaf Pani Authority Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for establishment of the Punjab Saaf Pani Authority.
repeals: The Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority Act, 2019
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Saaf Pani Authority to provide safe drinking water in Punjab, reconstituting the previous Aab-e-Pak Authority.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Saaf Pani Authority by re-constituting the former Punjab Aab-e-Pak Authority. The new body is empowered to provide safe drinking water, manage filtration plants, and issue licenses for water facilities across the province. It outlines the composition of the Authority, its functions, powers to impose fees, and procedures for annual reporting to the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.short_title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to update nomenclatures and provide speedy remedies for public order.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to address grave and emergent situations endangering peace and order. It substitutes the nomenclature of Zila Nazim and District Superintendent of Police within the relevant sections. The amendment provides preventive jurisdiction and speedy remedies for Deputy Commissioners or specially empowered officers in cases of nuisance or apprehended danger.

metadata.short_title: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.
metadata.one_line: Amends Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to update powers for preventing nuisance and danger in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 to address grave and emergent situations endangering peace and order. It specifically updates Section 144 regarding the power to issue orders in urgent cases of nuisance or apprehended danger. The amendment reflects changes in nomenclature for Zila Nazim and District Superintendent of Police while providing speedy remedies for public safety.

metadata.short_title: The Senate Hill University Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Senate Hill University in the private sector and to provide for matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
subjects: Faculty of Computer and Information Technology
Faculty of Management and Social Sciences
metadata.one_line: Establishes Senate Hill University in the private sector with faculties in IT, Management, Sciences, and Allied Health.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Senate Hill University as a body corporate in the private sector located in Lahore. The university is authorized to offer instruction across five specific faculties including Computer and Information Technology, Management, Sciences, and Allied Health Sciences. It creates governing bodies such as the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and Selection Board to manage administration, faculty appointments, and finance.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019
amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends Section 20 of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019 regarding appeal procedures.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act 2019 to address anomalies in appeal processes. It grants employees aggrieved by orders a right to prefer an appeal before the Speaker or the Governor within sixty days, depending on who passed the order. The amendment applies to all orders and specifically includes those passed after January 1, 2022.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
key_definitions: vehicle propelled mechanically or electrically either partially or completely
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to regulate electric and hybrid vehicles.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the registration and regulation of electric and hybrid vehicles. It substitutes definitions in section 2 to include mechanically or electrically propelled vehicles and hybrid vehicles. The Act also amends sections 25, 30, 32, and 34 regarding documentation, new registration marks for unregistered vehicles kept in the province, cancellation of transfers based on false information, and suspension orders.

name: LAHORE UNIVERSITY OF BIOLOGICAL AND APPLIED SCIENCES ACT 2023

metadata.short_title: The Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences.
establishes: Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences in the private sector within Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences as a body corporate in the private sector located in Lahore. It defines the university's powers to provide instruction, conduct research, and award degrees across various health and social sciences. The legislation outlines the structure of governing bodies, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and Selection Board, while setting out functions for budgeting, auditing, and student/teacher management.

Additionally, it omits section 5 of the parent Act and modifies rules concerning the vacancy of offices and administrator appointment.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Alternate Dispute Resolution (Amendment) Act, 2023

It establishes a new 'Authority' comprising retired judges and government officials to oversee these accreditations. The Act also creates a Director General position and defines various terms related to ADR proceedings and public servants within the context of this authority.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023

metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1961 Ordinance to add preliminary probes, arrest permissions, and revision powers for public servants.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Anti-Corruption Establishment Ordinance, 1961 to provide mechanisms safeguarding public servants from false complaints. It introduces provisions for preliminary probes to ascertain the veracity of facts before registering criminal cases or arresting officials. The text also establishes a revision power for the Chief Secretary to review orders and decisions made during these probes.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 by inserting specific words into Section 9. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary under Article 128 of the Constitution. The amendment adds the phrase 'equivalent or higher' regarding posts under a province.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2023

It substitutes subsection (2) of section 6 to state that the Prosecutor General holds office during the pleasure of the Government. Additionally, it omits subsection (5) of the same section. The Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab on April 13, 2023, to regulate client-attorney relationship norms.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance (Amendment) Act, 2023

The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on January 23, 2023, coming into force immediately upon publication.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2023

metadata.short_title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023

The legislation also substitutes new application forms for registration and adjusts penalties for non-compliance.

It defines the composition of the Authority, including government secretaries and non-official members, and outlines procedures for meetings, removal of members, and annual reporting to the Provincial Assembly.

The Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

It updates the name of the governing body to the Punjab Walled Cities and Heritage Areas Authority and broadens the definition of protected areas. The document also introduces new offences related to littering, spitting, vandalism, and sanitation violations within these heritage zones, prescribing fines up to ten thousand rupees. Additionally, it modifies the composition of the Authority and adjusts various time limits and penalties in the original Act.

Additionally, it introduces imprisonment terms for offenders who refuse to pay the fine and corresponding damage value, with sentence lengths varying based on the monetary value of the damage.

The legislation also details the powers of the university to confer degrees, conduct research, and manage its finances through specific committees.

It defines the university's corporate status, governing bodies including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Authority, and outlines its academic functions. The legislation also creates a University Fund, sets rules for statutes and regulations, and provides for the transition of existing employees and properties to the new university entity.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1962 to provide temporary measures for the pandemic. It allows the grant of certificates and diplomas based on approved promotion criteria instead of conventional examinations. The provision applies specifically to persons promoted or passed through such alternative criteria in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.

It establishes Market Committees for public sector markets and outlines their composition and tenure. metadata.summary: The Punjab Infectious Diseases (Prevention and Control) Act, 2020 was enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to prevent and control infectious diseases within the province. It empowers the Secretary, with the Chief Minister's approval, to declare infection threats, impose duties on medical practitioners, restrict gatherings, and manage dead bodies during outbreaks. The Act defines key terms such as 'potentially infectious person' and establishes confidentiality protocols for patient data while repealing the older Punjab Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958.

It grants the Secretary and Director General Health powers to impose duties on medical practitioners, restrict gatherings, manage dead bodies, and enforce quarantine measures. The Ordinance repeals the previous Punjab Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958, and applies to the entire province of Punjab.

It applies to dealers, manufacturers, and retailers throughout the whole of Punjab. The Act empowers officers to search premises without a warrant, seize contraband, auction seized items, and prosecute offenders with imprisonment up to three years and substantial fines.

It establishes a Provincial Policy Board and Boards of Governors for notified institutions, defining their composition, functions, and governance structures. The Act also provides powers to make rules and regulations, defines key terms related to faculty and staff, and repeals the previous Ordinance from 2019.

It empowers the Government to declare various categories of protected areas, including national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and wetlands, based on their ecological significance. The Act creates a Management Board comprising government officials and non-official experts to oversee these areas and defines key terms related to biodiversity and wildlife management.

The Commission has the power to investigate violations, impose penalties up to five hundred thousand rupees, and declare void contracts made in violation of the Act.
