name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab. It is necessary to establish the Madaaris and Schools Management Board; to manage the seized and freezed institutions; to ensure mainstreaming of students of such : institutions; and to provide for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify
repeals: The Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.one_line: Establishes a Board to manage seized and freezed madaaris and schools in Punjab and mainstream students.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab to efficiently manage and control seized and freezed educational institutions. It aims to ensure the mainstreaming of students from these institutions and provides for related matters. The Board is a body corporate with powers to acquire property, recruit staff, formulate budgets, and set up committees, while a Directorate manages the properties and student affairs under its control.

name: PUNJAB SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.short_title: Punjab Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to establish the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: from such date as the Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Establishes a Board to manage seized and freezed madaaris and schools in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Punjab to efficiently manage seized and freezed educational institutions. It defines the composition of the Board, including government secretaries and non-official members nominated by the Chief Minister. The Board is empowered to acquire property, recruit staff, formulate budgets, and manage student affairs for these specific institutions.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sentencing Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to lay down factors to be considered by courts while passing sentences to improve consistency in sentencing.
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may, by Notification in the official Gazette, appoint
metadata.one_line: This Act lays down factors for courts to consider when passing sentences in Punjab to ensure consistency.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Sentencing Act, 2019 establishes a framework for courts in Punjab to improve consistency in sentencing. It defines aggravating and mitigating factors that must be considered during trials and creates the Sentencing Council to oversee these practices. The Act applies to cases where imprisonment is a punishment but excludes capital punishment cases.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act 2010
amends: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
key_definitions: Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2010 Act to grant autonomy to the Punjab Skills Development Authority.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010. Its primary purpose is to give effect to regulatory and operational autonomy for the Punjab Skills Development Authority. The amendment specifically omits certain clauses from Section 5 of the parent Act regarding licensing and hostel approvals.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019.
amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
repeals: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2019 Village Panchayats Act to align with the Elections Act and update definitions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to bring it in harmony with the Elections Act, 2017. It updates various definitions, inserts new sections regarding delimitation by the Election Commission, and modifies provisions related to elections, voting rights, and recovery of dues. The Act also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance of 2019.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Skills Development Authority Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish the Punjab Skills Development Authority to promote and regulate the technical education and vocational training sector in the Punjab; and, for ancillary matters.
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may, by official Gazette, specify
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Skills Development Authority to regulate technical education and vocational training in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Skills Development Authority to promote and regulate the technical education and vocational training sector within the province. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to manage property, enter contracts, and establish regional offices, subject to government approval for immovable assets. Its composition includes a Chairperson, non-official members appointed by the Government, and ex officio members from various provincial departments. The Act provides for the framing of rules and regulations by the Government and allows for appeals against administrative orders.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019.
amends: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2019 Village Panchayats Act to align with the Elections Act, 2017 and adjust delimitation rules.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 to harmonize it with the Elections Act, 2017. It inserts new sections regarding the application of election provisions and the role of the Election Commission in delimitation. The document also substitutes various definitions and clauses related to voter eligibility, seat reservations for minorities, and recovery of dues as land revenue arrears.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Water Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to comprehensively manage and regulate water resources in the Punjab in the interest of conservation and sustainability.
repeals: The Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of 1975)
The Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 (XIX of 1976)
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes bodies to manage water resources in Punjab, regulates their use, and issues licenses for abstraction and disposal.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Water Act, 2019 provides a comprehensive framework for managing and regulating water resources within the province. It establishes the Punjab Water Resources Commission and the Punjab Water Services Regulatory Authority to oversee conservation, allocation, and proper use of water. The Act regulates the abstraction of water for domestic, agricultural, industrial, and ecological purposes through a licensing system and sets standards for water quality and effluent disposal.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act 2018.
metadata.commencement: at once and deemed to have taken effect on 15 October 2019
amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
repeals: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act 2018 regarding committee composition, fund transfer, and administrative functions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act 2018 to update provisions related to District and Local Zakat Committees. It modifies requirements for committee membership, including age limits and gender representation, and alters procedures for fund disbursement and administrative appointments. The Act also repeals the earlier Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance 2019.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act 2018
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
amends: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act 2018 to assign committee functions to the Deputy Commissioner upon expiry.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 to address the situation where a District Zakat and Ushr Committee's tenure expires without a new committee being constituted. It empowers the Government to assign the committee's functions to the Deputy Commissioner or another officer in the district administration (BPS 18 or above) acting as Administrator. The measure was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB VILLAGE PANCHAYATS AND NEIGHBOURHOOD COUNCILS ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to institutionalize and strengthen civic engagement for non-political action in the Punjab through constitution of village Panchayats and urban neighbourhood councils
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Punjab other than the areas notified as cantonments under the Cantonments Act, 1924 (Act II of 1924), or the Cantonments Ordinance, 2002 (CXXXVII of 2002)
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils in Punjab to strengthen civic engagement.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Village Panchayats and Neighbourhood Councils Act, 2019 was enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to institutionalize civic engagement through local bodies. It defines the structure, composition, and powers of Village Panchayats and urban Neighbourhood Councils across the province, excluding cantonments. The legislation outlines procedures for elections, codes of conduct for officials, grounds for disqualification, and mechanisms for suspension or removal of councils.

metadata.short_title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi and for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
repeals: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 2019 (IX of 2019)
metadata.one_line: Establishes Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi and provides for its governance, functions, and fund.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instructions in various branches of learning and conducting research. The Act defines key terms such as Academic Council, Syndicate, and Chancellor, and details the transfer of properties and employees from the former Government Postgraduate College for Women to the new university.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude certain notified areas from its operation.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to exclude specific lands from the Act's provisions regarding land revenue assessment and collection. It applies to areas notified by the Board of Revenue within the Province of Punjab. The Ordinance was promulgated because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: THE PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2019
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends Section 316 of the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 by substituting 'cease' for 'seize'.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 to substitute the word 'cease' for 'seize' in Section 316. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary. The amendment is effective immediately upon publication.

name: THE PUNJAB REGULARIZATION OF SERVICE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Regularization of Service (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Regularization of Service Act 2018.
metadata.commencement: at once and deemed to have taken effect on 22 October 2019
amends: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2018 Act to reduce regularization eligibility period from four to three years for contract employees in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 to facilitate the regularization of contract employees. It reduces the required period of continuous service from four years to three years and broadens the scope to include all contract employees serving for at least three years. The amendment specifies eligibility criteria such as available regular vacancies, qualification for the post, satisfactory performance, and non-opting to continue as a contract employee.

metadata.short_title: The Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi and for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
metadata.one_line: Establishes Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi as a body corporate with perpetual succession.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Rawalpindi Women University, Rawalpindi as a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal. It provides for the reconstitution of the Government Postgraduate College for Women, Satellite Town, Rawalpindi into the new university and transfers its properties, rights, liabilities, and employees to the university. The document defines various academic and administrative terms, outlines the functions of the university, and sets up mechanisms for rules, statutes, and regulations to govern its operations.

name: THE PUNJAB WORKERS WELFARE FUND ACT 2019

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Punjab Workers Welfare Fund.
repeals: The Workers' Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1971 (XXXVI of 1971)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund and mandates employer contributions based on total income.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Workers Welfare Fund to facilitate workers in the Province of Punjab. It mandates that establishments with a total income of at least Rs. 500,000 pay a contribution equal to two percent of their total income. The Act defines the composition of the Fund, the structure of the Governing Body, and outlines procedures for payment, recovery, and assessment of contributions, including penalties for default.

metadata.short_title: The University of Mianwali Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of University of Mianwali and for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
repeals: The University of Mianwali Ordinance, 2019
establishes: University of Sargodha sub-campus at Mianwali
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Mianwali by reconstituting its sub-campus and defines its functions, structure, and governance.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Mianwali as a body corporate by reconstituting the existing sub-campus of the University of Sargodha at Mianwali. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instructions, prescribing courses, holding examinations, and awarding degrees. The Act defines various bodies such as the Academic Council, Syndicate, and Chancellor, and details the transfer of properties, rights, and employees from the sub-campus to the new university.

metadata.short_title: The University of Mianwali Ordinance, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of University of Mianwali and for the matters connected therewith and ancillary thereto.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Mianwali as a body corporate with perpetual succession.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Mianwali by reconstituting the sub-campus of the University of Sargodha at Mianwali. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, a common seal, and the power to acquire property and enter contracts. The document defines various academic and administrative roles, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines the transfer of existing employees and liabilities from the sub-campus to the new University.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to prescribe fines for non-display of specific number plates.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to address penalties for failing to display security featured or vanity number plates. It inserts a new entry into the Twelfth Schedule of the Ordinance specifying fine amounts for motorcycles, cars/jeeps, and public service vehicles. The fines range from Rs. 1000 for motorcycles to Rs. 5000 for public carriers.

name: CHOLISTAN UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES BAHAWALPUR ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Bahawalpur.
establishes: Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur
metadata.one_line: Establishes Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur for animal health services, teaching, and research.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Cholistan University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Bahawalpur to promote animal health services through advanced teaching and research. It provides for the incorporation of the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and the power to hold property. The Act defines various bodies including the Academic Council, Syndicate, and committees for affiliation and discipline, while also transferring assets from the former University College of Veterinary and Animal Sciences.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Charities Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to register and regulate charities and collection of charitable funds.
repeals: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018
metadata.one_line: An Act to register and regulate charities and the collection of charitable funds in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration, administration, and regulation of charities and fund-raising appeals within the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'charity', 'charitable purpose', and 'promoter' to establish a clear legal framework for collecting donations. The Act establishes the Charity Commission to oversee these activities and repeals the previous Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953.

metadata.short_title: Punjab Agriculture Policy, 2017
establishes: Punjab Seed Certification and Registration Authority
Punjab Horticulture Research and Development Institute (PHRDI)
Directorate of Human Resource and Capacity Development
metadata.administering_body: Agriculture Department, Government of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: The Punjab Agriculture Policy, 2017 outlines a strategy to transform the sector into a diversified, sustainable, and market-driven industry.
metadata.summary: This document is a policy notification issued by the Government of the Punjab to guide the transformation of the agriculture sector. It aims to achieve a sustainable growth rate through ICT empowerment, efficient resource use, and revamping existing practices. The policy focuses on three guiding principles: a market-oriented approach where the government refrains from direct production activities, continuous capacity building for institutions, and strong linkages across departments and stakeholders. Specific initiatives include establishing new authorities like PAMRA and PHRDI, targeting small commercial farmers, women, and rural youth, and phasing out unproductive subsidies to fund higher-value areas.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to register and regulate charities and collection of charitable funds.
repeals: The Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.one_line: This Ordinance establishes a Charity Commission to register and regulate charities and charitable fund collections in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Charities Ordinance, 2018 was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to register and regulate charities and the collection of charitable funds. It applies to the whole of Punjab and comes into force immediately. The Ordinance establishes a Commission consisting of Commissioners appointed by the Government to oversee these functions. It repeals the Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953, and provides for rules and regulations regarding declarations, accounts, and audits.

name: PUNJAB EDUCATION INITIATIVES MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority.
repeals: The Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority Ordinance, 2017 (XIV of 2017)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority to manage education sector initiatives via public-private partnerships.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Education Initiatives Management Authority (PEIMA) as a body corporate to devise and manage dynamic initiatives in the education sector. The Authority operates in partnership with the private sector, specifically non-governmental organizations, to achieve its objectives. It includes provisions for transferring existing programs and posts from the Punjab Education Foundation to the new Authority upon its establishment.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Hepatitis Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for surveillance, diagnosis and treatment of hepatitis.
repeals: The Punjab Hepatitis Ordinance, 2017
metadata.one_line: Establishes a surveillance system for hepatitis diagnosis, treatment, and prevention in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Surveillance System under the control of the Director General Health Services to manage patient care, data collection, and awareness campaigns. The legislation imposes specific responsibilities on healthcare facilities regarding testing protocols, waste disposal, and safe blood transfusion practices while repealing the previous Ordinance from 2017.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to levy, alter and rationalize certain taxes and duties in the Punjab.
key_definitions: certificate or other document evidencing right
metadata.one_line: This Act levies and alters taxes/duties in Punjab and amends the Stamp Act, PRA Act, and previous Finance Act.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Finance Act, 2018 was enacted to levy, alter, and rationalize certain taxes and duties within the province of Punjab. It came into force on November 1, 2018, following its passage by the Provincial Assembly and assent by the Governor. The Act primarily functions as an amendment instrument, updating schedules in the Stamp Act 1899 regarding various instruments like contracts and insurance policies, while also amending the Punjab Revenue Authority Act 2012 and the Punjab Finance Act 2016 to adjust tax rates and categories.

name: PUNJAB SIKH ANAND KARAJ MARRIAGE ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sikh Anand Karaj Marriage Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for solemnization and registration of Sikh marriages.
repeals: The Anand Marriage Act, 1909 (VII of 1909)
metadata.max_penalty: fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Act regulates and provides for the solemnization and registration of Sikh marriages known as Anand Karaj in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Sikh Anand Karaj Marriage Act, 2018 establishes provisions for the solemnization and registration of Sikh marriages conducted under the Anand Karaj ceremony. It defines key terms such as 'Anand Karaj', 'Granthi', and 'Sikh', and sets conditions for marriage including age limits and consent. The Act mandates the registration of all Sikh marriages by designated registrars and provides a mechanism for arbitration and dissolution of marriage through an Arbitration Council.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 to allow up to four external sound systems.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 to increase the permitted number of external sound systems from one to not more than four. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session. The amendment specifically substitutes the phrase 'one external sound system' with 'not more than four external sound systems' in section 4, subsection (2), clause (a) of the parent Act.

name: PUNJAB SAFE MEDICAL SUPPLIES AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish an Authority for procuring drugs and medical equipment and providing them to the public health facilities in the Punjab
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may notify
metadata.max_penalty: five hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Establishes an Authority to procure and distribute quality drugs and medical equipment to public health facilities in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Safe Medical Supplies Authority to ensure the procurement of quality drugs and medical equipment for distribution to public health facilities in the province. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to enter contracts, acquire property, and frame regulations, subject to government approval for immovable property disposal. It defines key terms such as 'drug', 'equipment', and 'health facility' and outlines the composition of the Authority, including members from the Provincial Assembly and various departments. The Act also provides for administrative penalties for non-compliance with certificates or licenses and grants indemnity to officials acting in good faith.

name: PUNJAB TIANJIN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY LAHORE ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act for the establishment of Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore.
repeals: The Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore Ordinance, 2017 (XVI of 2017)
establishes: Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore
metadata.one_line: Establishes Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore and provides for its functions, governance, and finances.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Tianjin University of Technology Lahore as a body corporate to undertake research and development for producing high-quality technical human resources. It incorporates existing government institutes into the new university structure and transfers their properties, liabilities, and employees to the university. The Act outlines the functions of the university, its financial management through a dedicated fund, and provisions for rules, statutes, and regulations governing its administration.

metadata.short_title: The Bahawalpur Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991.
repeals: The Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991 (XI of 1991)
metadata.status_evidence: An Act to repeal the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991.
metadata.one_line: Repeals the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow reconstitution under the Development of Cities Act, 1976.
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991. The repeal is intended to enable the constitution of the Bahawalpur Development Authority under the provisions of the Development of Cities Act, 1976. This aligns the authority with those constituted in other cities of Punjab for orderly and planned growth.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to make provisions relating to assessment, collection and disbursement of Zakat and Ushri in the Punjab.
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Zakat and Ushr Department
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in the Province of Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Zakat and Ushr Act, 2018 establishes a legal framework for assessing and collecting Zakat and Ushr within the Punjab province. It applies to Muslim residents, companies, and associations owning assets liable to Zakat. The Act defines specific rates for agricultural produce and livestock, sets up councils and committees for administration, and outlines the roles of the Chief Administrator and various local bodies.

name: THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to update provisions on small claims courts, execution, costs, and appeals in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to update certain provisions applicable in the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'Court of Small Causes' with 'Court of Small Claims and Minor Offences', modifies rules regarding execution of decrees from reciprocating territories, and adjusts limits for second appeals. The Act also introduces new powers for courts to apply fair procedures for expeditious disposal and alters provisions concerning costs and review of judgments.

metadata.short_title: The Explosive Substances (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Explosive Substances Act, 1908.
metadata.one_line: Amends section 7 of the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 regarding trial consent timelines in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Explosive Substances Act, 1908 specifically for its application to the Province of the Punjab. It modifies section 7 by substituting a full stop with a colon and adding a proviso concerning trial consent. The amendment deems consent given if the Provincial Government does not convey its decision within sixty days of receiving a report under section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.

metadata.short_title: The Limitation (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Limitation Act, 1908
metadata.one_line: Amends the Limitation Act, 1908 to set a ninety-day limit for filing revision petitions under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Limitation Act, 1908 by inserting a new article into its First Schedule. The amendment specifically addresses the time limit for filing revision petitions under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. It establishes a limitation period of ninety days from the date of the decision sought to be revised.

metadata.short_title: The Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Compantes Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968.
metadata.parent_law: Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010
subjects: Punjab Companies' Profits Workers' Participation Committee
establishes: Punjab Companies' Profits Workers' Participation Committee
metadata.one_line: Amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to adapt it for Punjab jurisdiction and establish a local committee.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 1968 to align its provisions with the Punjab context. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab and changes 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab'. The law establishes a new committee to monitor implementation and updates definitions regarding profits and workers within the province.

name: THE PUNJAB BONDED LABOUR SYSTEM (ABOLITION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Bonded Labour System (Abolition) (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992.
metadata.parent_law: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992
establishes: Sub-Committee of the Provincial Vigilance Committee
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or with fine
metadata.administering_body: Labour and Human Resource Departments of the Government
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1992 Act to include forced labour, define new terms, protect against eviction, and establish a Provincial Vigilance Committee.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992 to expand its scope from bonded labour to include forced labour. It introduces definitions for key terms like 'employer' and 'establishment', mandates protection against eviction for released labourers, and establishes a Provincial Vigilance Committee to monitor implementation. The amendment also updates provisions regarding advances (peshgi), offences, and the roles of various committees.

name: THE PUNJAB COMPULSORY TEACHING OF THE HOLY QURAN ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for making compulsory teaching of the Holy Quran to Muslim students in all educational institutions
metadata.one_line: This Act makes teaching the Holy Quran compulsory for Muslim students in Punjab's educational institutions.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Compulsory Teaching of the Holy Quran Act, 2018 mandates the teaching of the Holy Quran to Muslim students in all educational institutions within the Province of Punjab. It requires Naazrah Quran (recitation by sighting) for classes I to V and translation of the entire Holy Quran for classes VI to XII. The Government of the Punjab is responsible for ensuring implementation through prescribed rules.

name: THE PUNJAB AGRICULTURAL MARKETING REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the systematic growth and transformation of the marketing of agricultural produce.
repeals: Punjab Agricultural Produce Market Ordinance, 1978
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment up to six months or fine up to five hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Establishes a regulatory authority to facilitate and regulate agricultural produce marketing in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Agricultural Marketing Regulatory Authority to systematically grow and transform the marketing of agricultural produce. It defines various roles such as growers, dealers, and key service providers while setting up collection centers and virtual markets. The legislation also outlines penalties for malpractice and provides mechanisms for resolving marketing disputes between sellers and buyers.

name: THE PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE INSPECTORATE ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to introduce an effective system of monitoring and inspection of the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service.
metadata.one_line: Establishes an Inspectorate to monitor and inspect the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service Inspectorate to introduce a system for monitoring and inspecting the prosecution service. The Inspectorate consists of a Director General, Directors, Chief Inspectors, and Inspectors, with at least half of inspection staff required to be former public prosecutors. Its functions include monitoring performance, conducting periodic inspections, advising the government on improvements, and performing research for reforms. The Act empowers the Inspectorate to summon records from various agencies and requires an annual report to be submitted by September 30th.

name: THE PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004.
amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2004 Act to allow disposal of houses/plots to serving members aged 58 or older.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to facilitate the disposal of houses and plots. It specifically targets in-service Government Servants who have attained a specified age. The amendment allows for the disposal of excess properties to serving members who are not less than fifty-eight years of age.

metadata.short_title: The Drugs (Punjab Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Drugs Act, 1976.
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which shall extend to seven years and with fine which may extend to one and a half million rupees but which shall not be less than five times the value of the drug taken into custody
metadata.one_line: Amends the Drugs Act, 1976 by omitting sections and amending penalties for drug offences.
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to update provisions regarding spurious or adulterated drugs. It omits specific sections (23A, 23B, 23C, 27A) and modifies penalty clauses within sections 27, 28, and others. The legislation also introduces a new section on the recall of drugs that have not caused death or disability and adjusts quorum requirements for Drug Courts.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to align with the Punjab Land Records Authority Act 2017.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to harmonize it with the Punjab Land Records Authority Act 2017. It updates definitions regarding Arazi Record Centres and omits references to Service Centre Officials. The amendments also adjust provisions related to reporting land rights, mutation fees, and computerized record management.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Legal Aid Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a legal aid agency to provide legal aid to the indigent persons.
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months but shall not be less than seven days
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Legal Aid Agency to provide legal services to indigent persons in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Legal Aid Agency to provide legal aid to indigent persons within the province. The Agency is headed by a Director General appointed by the Government and consists of employees appointed in the prescribed manner. Its functions include evolving policies for legal aid, accrediting panels of advocates, advising on fair trial rights, and conducting research. The Act defines key terms such as 'indigent person' and 'family dispute', outlines the application process for legal aid, and prescribes penalties for providing false information or unauthorized disclosure.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend certain laws of the Punjab to harmonize them with the Local Government system envisaged under Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960
Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962
The Punjab Recovery of Cost (Copies of Essential Revenue Records) Ordinance, 1963
The Punjab Acquisition of Land (Housing) (Repeal) Act, 1985
The Lahore Ring Road Authority Act, 2011
The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012
The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends various Punjab laws to align terminology with the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends specific laws of the Punjab to harmonize them with the local government system established under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013. It achieves this by substituting terms like 'Executive District Officer' with 'Commissioner', and updating references to local bodies to reflect the new structure. The amendments apply across various sectors including land acquisition, agriculture, health, and revenue administration within the Province of Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to extend administrator terms.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to extend the term of office for Administrators of District Education and Health Authorities. It substitutes 'two years' for 'twelve months' in section 30, subsection (3) of the parent Act. The measure was promulgated by the Governor because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE PUNJAB SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969.
amends: The Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1969 Ordinance to remove registration fees and update application forms for establishments in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 to facilitate business activities by withdrawing the requirement for registration and renewal fees. It specifically alters Section 24 of the parent Ordinance to change the form requirements for employer applications and removes references to prescribed fee deposits. The legislation was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: THE PUNJAB REGULARIZATION OF SERVICE ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for appointment on regular basis.
metadata.territorial_extent: whole of Province of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: This Act regularizes contract employees in Punjab departments who meet specific eligibility criteria.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Regularization of Service Act, 2018 provides for the appointment on a regular basis of certain employees serving on contract in the Province of Punjab. It applies to all persons employed on contract immediately before the commencement of the Act, excluding those in projects or on daily wages. The Act establishes Scrutiny Committees to verify eligibility and qualifications, outlines procedures for regularization, determines seniority based on continuous service, and sets rules regarding pay fixation and termination of contracts for those not recommended for regularization.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015
repeals: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2018
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 to allow four external sound systems at places of worship.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 to increase the permitted number of external sound systems at places of worship from one to four. The amendment specifically allows these systems for Azan, religious prayers, announcements of death, or lost and found items. It also repeals a previous Ordinance issued in 2018 regarding the same subject matter.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Witness Protection Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to protect witnesses and other persons connected with certain criminal proceedings.
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years but which shall not be less than thirty days and with fine which may extend to rupees five million but which shall not be less than rupees one hundred thousand
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes a board and units to protect witnesses in terrorism and serious criminal cases in Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Witness Protection Act, 2018 provides measures to protect witnesses and other persons connected with criminal proceedings involving terrorism or serious offences. It establishes a Witness Protection Board and specific Units to oversee protection measures, which may include relocation, identity changes, and financial assistance. The Act outlines the criteria for granting protection, procedures for witness anonymity orders, and penalties for violating these provisions.

metadata.short_title: The Registration (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Registration Act, 1908 to include specific attorney instruments and sale agreements in registration requirements.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 by adding new clauses regarding the registration of instruments granting power to an attorney or constituting agreements to sell rights in immovable property. Specifically, it inserts a provision for registering instruments involving immovable property valued at one hundred rupees and upwards. Additionally, it modifies subsection (2) of section 17 to exclude documents granting such powers from certain exceptions related to the said value.

metadata.short_title: The Registration (Second Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months but which shall not be less than ten days and with fine which may extend to two hundred thousand rupees but which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Amends the Registration Act, 1908 to regulate conveyance writing and impose penalties on unlicensed practitioners.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to further regulate and supervise the profession of conveyance writing. It inserts a new clause into section 69 regarding the regulation of this profession. Additionally, it introduces a new section 81A that imposes penalties on individuals who engage in conveyance writing without valid enrolment or license.

name: THE PUNJAB UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY RASUL ACT 2018

metadata.short_title: The Punjab University of Technology Rasul Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of University of Technology Rasul.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab University of Technology Rasul and provides for its incorporation, functions, and finances.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab University of Technology Rasul by reconstituting the Government College of Technology Rasul. It grants the university corporate status, defines its academic and research functions, and creates a dedicated University Fund. The legislation also outlines provisions for employee transfers, rule-making powers, and indemnity for officials acting in good faith.

metadata.short_title: The University of Sialkot Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University of Sialkot.
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Sialkot in the private sector and defines its structure and functions.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Sialkot as a body corporate located in Sialkot within the private sector. It outlines the composition of the university, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Board, and various committees like the Finance and Planning Committee. The legislation grants the university powers to establish departments, conduct examinations, award degrees, and manage its finances and staff appointments.

metadata.short_title: The University of Murree Ordinance, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of the University of Murree.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Murree and provides for its incorporation, functions, governance, and finances.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the University of Murree as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's functions, including providing instruction in geology, geography, and forestry, prescribing courses, holding examinations, and awarding degrees. The document defines various roles such as Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Syndicate, and sets up the University Fund to manage income from fees and donations.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ACT 2017

metadata.short_title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 (VI of 1991)
The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance 2017 (X of 2017)
metadata.one_line: Repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 and the corresponding 2017 Ordinance to allow reconstitution under the Development of Cities Act.
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991, and the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance 2017. The purpose is to enable the constitution of the authority under the provisions of the Development of Cities Act 1976 for orderly city growth. Savings clauses ensure that rules, contracts, rights, and liabilities incurred under the repealed Act continue in effect unless specifically cancelled.

name: DERA GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.short_title: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
repeals: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.status_evidence: The Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 (VI of 1991) is hereby repealed.
subjects: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
key_definitions: Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: This Ordinance repeals the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 to allow reconstitution under the Development of cities Act 1976.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991. The repeal is necessary so that the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority can be constituted under the provisions of the Development of cities Act 1976, similar to authorities in other Punjab cities. The Ordinance was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.short_title: The Faisalabad Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Faisalabad Medical University
repeals: The Faisalabad Medical University Ordinance, 2017 (VI of 2017)
metadata.one_line: Establishes Faisalabad Medical University by upgrading Punjab Medical College Faisalabad.
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and upgrades Punjab Medical College Faisalabad into Faisalabad Medical University to improve medical education and research. It establishes the University as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defining its structure including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council. The Act outlines the University's functions such as prescribing courses, holding examinations, awarding degrees, and managing its financial provisions through a dedicated University Fund.

metadata.short_title: The University of Narowal Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act for the establishment of University of Narowal
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Narowal by reconstituting the sub-campus of University of Gujrat at Narowal.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Narowal by reconstituting the existing sub-campus of the University of Gujrat located in Narowal. It grants the new university corporate status, defines its structure including a Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various authorities, and outlines its functions such as providing instruction, conducting examinations, and awarding degrees. The Act also creates a University Fund to manage income from fees and donations, establishes rules for staff transfer and absorption, and provides mechanisms for appeals and the making of internal regulations.

metadata.short_title: The Faisalabad Medical University Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of Faisalabad Medical University
metadata.one_line: Establishes Faisalabad Medical University by reconstituting Punjab Medical College Faisalabad.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Faisalabad Medical University by reconstituting Punjab Medical College Faisalabad. It provides for the university's functions, including education, research, examinations, and degree awards. The document defines various authorities such as the Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines financial provisions and appeal mechanisms.

metadata.short_title: The Nishtar Medical University Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Nishtar Medical University
repeals: The Nishtar Medical University Ordinance, 2017 (VII of 2017)
metadata.one_line: Establishes Nishtar Medical University by upgrading Nishtar Medical College Multan and provides for its governance, functions, and finances.
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes Nishtar Medical College Multan as Nishtar Medical University to improve medical education and research. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defining its structure including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Syndicate. The Act outlines the university's functions such as conducting examinations, awarding degrees, managing funds, and regulating staff employment.

metadata.short_title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012.
amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
repeals: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.one_line: Amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012 to update definitions, leasing powers, and park usage rules.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012 to align its provisions with current necessities. It expands the definition of 'person' to include bodies owned by federal or provincial governments. The Act also grants the Authority power to lease sites for advertisements and permits the deployment of public park areas for food, playing facilities, and plant sales without adversely affecting the park's character.

metadata.short_title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012.
metadata.parent_law: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
amends: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012 to update definitions and leasing powers.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act 2012 to align its provisions with current necessities. It expands the definition of 'person' to include bodies owned by federal or provincial governments. The text also grants the Authority new powers to lease sites for advertisements and permits food vendors in public parks under specific conditions.

metadata.short_title: The Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Police Order, 2002.
metadata.parent_law: Police Order, 2002 (C.E. Order No. 22 of 2002)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Police Order, 2002 regarding the appointment of Provincial Police Officers in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 to rationalize provisions concerning the appointment of Provincial Police Officers within the Province of the Punjab. It specifically omits a reference to the National Public Safety Commission from Article 11, clause (1) of the original order. The legislation was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act Further to amend the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002.
amends: The Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002
repeals: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.administering_body: the Industries, Commerce and Investment Department of the Government
metadata.one_line: Amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to include pressure vessels in regulations and update inspection procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance, 2002 to extend its scope to cover pressure vessels alongside boilers. It updates various sections regarding registration, inspection timelines, and the roles of the Inspection Authority and Inspector. The legislation also modifies definitions related to departments and qualifications for boiler engineers.

metadata.short_title: The Nishtar Medical University Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of Nishtar Medical University and to reconstitute and upgrade Nishtar Medical College Multan as a University for purposes of imparting better medical education, encouraging and arranging extensive research and publications in the field of medical sciences, holding examinations and awarding medical degrees and for ancillary matters.
metadata.one_line: Establishes Nishtar Medical University by upgrading Nishtar Medical College Multan to provide medical education and research.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Nishtar Medical University by reconstituting Nishtar Medical College Multan. It empowers the new university to impart medical education, conduct research, hold examinations, and award degrees. The document defines various university bodies including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines financial provisions for the University Fund.

It updates various sections regarding registration, inspection timelines, and the roles of the Inspection Authority and Inspector. name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006.
amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006
repeals: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2006 Act regarding the Prosecutor General's appointment, term, and procedures for guilty pleas.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2006 to rationalize provisions concerning the service. It establishes the Prosecutor General as the head of the Service, defines a three-year term with a possible two-year extension, and outlines procedures for evidence assessment and punishment proposals when an accused pleads guilty. The Act also replaces specific terms regarding supervision and control with 'directions'.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Administration Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to institute a comprehensive system of civil administration in the Punjab for efficient administration and improved service delivery to the people.
repeals: The Punjab Civil Administration Ordinance, 2016
metadata.one_line: Institutes a comprehensive system of civil administration in Punjab for efficient service delivery and improved coordination.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a comprehensive system of civil administration across the Punjab to ensure efficient governance and better service delivery. It defines the roles, functions, and powers of Commissioners, Deputy Commissioners, and Assistant Commissioners at various administrative levels. The legislation also creates mechanisms for grievance redressal through Divisional Redress Boards and mandates transparency in public administration.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2017

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006
amends: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2006 Act regarding the Prosecutor General's appointment, tenure, and powers to propose punishment for guilty pleas.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006 to rationalize provisions concerning the service. It specifically alters Section 6 to define the Prosecutor General's appointment terms, a three-year tenure with possible two-year extensions, and conditions for re-appointment after five years. Additionally, it modifies Section 9 to require prosecutors to submit written assessments of evidence and propose punishments when an accused pleads guilty or during case summation. Finally, Section 13 is amended to replace the phrase 'supervision and control' with 'directions'.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Drugs Act, 1976, in its application to Province of the Punjab for control and eradication of spurious, adulterated and substandard drugs.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to strengthen control over spurious and substandard drugs in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to address the increasing menace of spurious, adulterated, and substandard drugs in the Province of Punjab. It introduces new definitions for drug testing laboratories and monitoring teams, updates enforcement mechanisms, and provides for stricter penalties. The legislation establishes Provincial Drugs Monitoring Teams with powers to inspect premises, recommend license cancellations, and submit monthly reports to both Federal and Provincial Governments.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to abolish, rationalize and merge certain taxes and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.one_line: Abolishes and rationalizes certain taxes and duties in Punjab while amending the Stamp Act, 1899.
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes, rationalizes, and merges specific taxes and duties within the province of Punjab. It comes into force on July 1, 2017, extending to the whole of the Punjab. The primary mechanism involves amending the Stamp Act, 1899 to insert new clauses defining 'urban areas' and updating stamp duty rates for various instruments like certificates of sale, conveyances, and exchanges.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Hepatitis Ordinance, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for surveillance, diagnosis and treatment of hepatitis
metadata.one_line: Establishes a surveillance system for hepatitis diagnosis, treatment, and prevention in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of hepatitis within the Province of Punjab. It establishes a Surveillance System under the control of the Director General Health Services to manage patient care, conduct epidemiological studies, and coordinate awareness campaigns. The document also mandates specific responsibilities for healthcare facilities regarding testing protocols, safe blood transfusions using screened blood, proper disposal of hospital waste, and the use of auto-disabled syringes.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to extend administrator appointments and assign sanitation/waste duties to councils.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to extend the period for appointing Administrators. It assigns functions regarding sanitation and waste collection/disposal (domestic, industrial, hospital) to District Councils and Union Councils. The Act also assists Union Councils in rural water supply schemes and public drinking water sources.

amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
repeals: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to align it with the local government system under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013. It substitutes references to 'District Coordination Officer' with 'Deputy Commissioner' across multiple sections and clauses of the 1960 Ordinance. Additionally, it repeals the earlier Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2017.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Records Authority Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Punjab Land Records Authority for reform and modernization of the system of land records.

metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize land records in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority as a body corporate to manage, update, and maintain land records. It aims to improve service delivery, ensure tenure security, and modernize the system through policies and strategies. The Authority is empowered to establish Arazi Record Centres, computerize records, and coordinate with other government departments like the Board of Revenue.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (PROMOTION AND REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2017

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Private Educational Institutions (Promotion and Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2017

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Shehr-e-Khamoshan Authority to establish, manage, and regulate model cemeteries, graveyards, and crematoriums in the Punjab. The Authority is empowered to provide cemetery, funeral, crematory, and transfer services to the public. It defines the composition of the Authority, including members from the Provincial Assembly, government officials, philanthropists, and technocrats, and outlines their tenure and disqualifications. It defines various services including burial, cremation, and transfer of remains, and outlines the composition and powers of the Authority. The Authority is empowered to manage these facilities while maintaining proper accounts subject to audit by the Auditor General.

The amendments allow Metropolitan Corporations, Municipal Corporations, Municipal Committees, and rural Union Councils with urban characteristics to determine higher property tax rates under the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 as it applies to the Province of Punjab. Specifically, it omits the requirement for appointment by the National Public Safety Commission from a list provided within Article 11 of the original order. The legislation rationalizes provisions relating to the appointment of Provincial Police Officers and comes into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004 to facilitate the registration of organizations managing accommodation for destitute and neglected children. It introduces new categories of children at risk, such as those with disabilities, imprisoned with mothers, or abandoned by parents. The legislation also substitutes existing sections to increase penalties for offences like employing children for begging, rag picking, and intoxication, while omitting certain obsolete sections.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ehtram-e-Ramazan Ordinance, 1981 specifically for its application within the Province of the Punjab. It updates existing provisions by substituting references from 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab' and increasing various fines from five hundred rupees to fifty thousand rupees. Additionally, it grants Magistrates or Assistant Commissioners power to enter public places and arrest persons committing offences under the Ordinance, while shifting jurisdictional authority from the Federal Government to the Provincial Government.

It expressly grants a right of appeal to former employees and adjusts time limits for decision-making in disciplinary cases. The amendments also allow the Cabinet Committee on Legislation to grant further time if delays are due to reasons beyond control.

The amendments also address the continuity of rules and actions taken under previously omitted sections.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to remove restrictions on double membership in specific cases. It also omits provisions concerning the dissolution of local governments to strengthen them. Additionally, it empowers Deputy Mayors or Vice Chairmen to preside over meetings of various local government bodies.

Additionally, it updates provisions related to assisting Union Councils in rural water supply schemes.

metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Women Protection Authority to protect women against violence in the province.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Women Protection Authority to provide a comprehensive system for the protection, relief, and rehabilitation of women against all forms of violence in the Punjab. The Authority is a body corporate headed by a Chairperson appointed by the Government and consists of members from the Provincial Assembly, police, social welfare, women development, public prosecution departments, as well as non-official members. It has powers to establish protection centers, formulate policies, monitor the administration, and ensure standards for persons engaged in the protection system.

It further stipulates that the general discussion on these budget proposals shall take place for at least four days during the session.

It creates a Board of Superintending Canal Officers to handle revisional jurisdiction and makes specific offences under section 70 cognizable and non-bailable. The legislation also grants civil courts jurisdiction over claims against the Provincial Government while restricting court interference in certain administrative proceedings.

The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on September 5, 2016, coming into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority Ordinance, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to establish the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority for forensic examination and testing of fertilizer, pesticides, food and drugs.
establishes: Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority for forensic testing of fertilizers, pesticides, food, and drugs.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Agriculture, Food and Drug Authority to conduct forensic examinations and testing of fertilizers, pesticides, food, and drugs. The Authority is empowered to render expert opinions on ingredient quality and deal with related matters across the whole of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'drug', 'fertilizer', and 'pesticide' by reference to existing Acts and Orders, and outlines the composition and functions of the Authority.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963.
amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.administering_body: Livestock and Dairy Development Department of the Government
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1963 Act to regulate animal slaughter, define useful animals, and establish monitoring mechanisms in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to provide a more effective system for regulating and controlling the slaughter of animals. It updates definitions regarding carcasses, local authorities, and useful animals, while restricting slaughter to approved slaughterhouses and specific days. The legislation also introduces presumptions for prosecutions, mandates record-keeping for skins and hides, and establishes mechanisms for monitoring performance by relevant authorities.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS FEED STUFF AND COMPOUND FEED ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Animals Feed Stuff and Compound Feed Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate poultry production activities in the Punjab; It is necessary to regulate the manufacture, storage, supply, transport for sale and marketing of feed stuff and compound feed in the Province of the Punjab; to ensure standards of production and quality of feed stuff; to check adulteration and misbranding deal with of poultry and livestock feed stuff and compound feed ingredients; and, to ancillary matters.
repeals: The Punjab Animals Compound Feed and Feed Stuff Ordinance, 2002 (LXVIII of 2002)
establishes: Tribunal constituted under section 38 of the Punjab Livestock Breeding Act 2014 (XIII of 2014)
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years but which shall not be less than one year and with fine which may extend to five hundred thousand rupees but which shall not be less than three hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Regulates manufacture, storage, supply, and marketing of animal feed in Punjab while ensuring quality standards.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates poultry production activities and the manufacture, storage, supply, transport for sale, and marketing of feed stuff and compound feed in the Province of the Punjab. It aims to ensure production and quality standards, check adulteration and misbranding of poultry and livestock feed ingredients, and address ancillary matters. The Act defines key terms such as 'feed stuff', 'compound feed', and 'adulterated', establishes a Tribunal for trial of offences, and repeals the Punjab Animals Compound Feed and Feed Stuff Ordinance, 2002.

name: PUNJAB ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to rationalize provisions in section 3A. Specifically, it substitutes clause (b) of section 3A to clarify that meat or carcasses without proper slaughter-house stamps, marks, tags, or certification are considered slaughtered in contravention of the Act. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on September 5, 2016, coming into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Administration Ordinance, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to institute a comprehensive system of civil administration in the Punjab for efficient administration and improved service delivery to the people.
