metadata.status_evidence: It shall come into force on and from the day repealed.
metadata.one_line: Institutes a comprehensive civil administration system in Punjab for efficient service delivery and coordination.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive system of civil administration across the Punjab to ensure efficient governance and improved public service delivery. It defines roles for Commissioners, Deputy Commissioners, and Assistant Commissioners to supervise administration and coordinate work across divisions and districts. The document also creates Divisional Boards and Grievance Redress Boards to handle maladministration and public grievances while ensuring transparency and due diligence.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Blood Transfusion Safety Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate collection, testing, processing, storage, distribution, issuance, transfusion of human blood, blood components, ensuring health protection and prevention of transfusion transmissible diseases.
repeals: The Punjab Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 1999 (XXXVI of 1999)
metadata.one_line: Regulates blood collection, testing, storage, and transfusion safety in Punjab while repealing the 1999 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the entire chain of human blood management, including collection, testing, processing, storage, distribution, and issuance for transfusion. It aims to ensure health protection and prevent transfusion-transmissible diseases by establishing strict standards and safety protocols. The legislation applies to all entities involved in the blood transfusion chain within Punjab, excluding blood stem cells, and mandates voluntary, anonymous, and non-remunerated donation. It establishes the Punjab Blood Transfusion Authority to oversee these operations and repeals the previous Punjab Transfusion of Safe Blood Ordinance, 1999.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2016

subjects: Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to increase the pecuniary jurisdiction of District Appellate Courts. It updates legal references to align with the Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002 and clarifies definitions for Government and High Court within the province. The Act also omits specific sections and the Schedule from the original Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962.
subjects: Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002

It updates legal references to align with the Small Claims and Minor Offences Courts Ordinance, 2002 and omits specific sections from the original Ordinance. The document was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: PUNJAB CIVILIAN VICTIMS OF TERRORISM (RELIEF AND REHABILITATION) ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the institutionalized response to redress the hardship faced by the civilian victims and their families owing to an act of terrorism.
repeals: The Punjab Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.one_line: Provides relief, healthcare, and rehabilitation grants to civilian victims of terrorism in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an institutionalized response to assist civilian victims and their families affected by acts of terrorism. It entitles victims to financial grants based on the nature of harm suffered, ranging from death to property damage. The Government is required to establish a dedicated Civilian Victims Fund to ensure timely payment of these benefits. Additionally, the Act mandates immediate free medical treatment for victims and outlines procedures for ascertaining victim status and recommending rehabilitation measures.

name: PUNJAB COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act 2014.
amends: The Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2014 Act regarding member appointments, age limits, and remuneration scales.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2014 to update provisions related to the appointment of members. It specifies that appointed members must be between thirty and sixty-five years old with relevant experience in women's rights issues. The legislation also substitutes text regarding remuneration scales for the Chairperson and outlines procedures for filling vacancies within thirty days.

name: PUNJAB CIVILIAN VICTIMS OF TERRORISM (RELIEF AND REHABILITATION) ORDINANCE 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civilian Victims of Terrorism (Relief and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the institutionalized response to redress the hardship faced by the civilian victims and their families owing to an act of terrorism.
metadata.one_line: Provides relief, healthcare, and rehabilitation grants to civilian victims of terrorism in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes an institutionalized mechanism to provide timely recognition and assistance to civilian victims of terrorism in the Punjab. It entitles victims and their families to financial grants for harm caused to body, mind, or property, as well as free medical treatment from government facilities. The document also creates a dedicated Civilian Victims Fund and outlines procedures for ascertaining victims, assessing damages including livestock and property loss, and providing rehabilitation measures such as vocational training.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Drugs (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Drugs Act, 1976.
subjects: substitution of federal with provincial authority
metadata.one_line: Amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to transfer Drug Court powers from Federal to Provincial Government.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 to align provisions regarding Drug Courts with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government in section 31 of the Drugs Act, 1976. Consequently, all powers previously exercisable by the Federal Government over existing Drug Courts in Punjab are transferred to the Provincial Government upon commencement.

name: PUNJAB CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2016

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act 2006 to clarify provisions regarding the superintendence and administration of the Service. It vests administrative control in the Prosecutor General while ensuring Public Prosecutors perform functions under their directions. The Act also mandates a code of conduct for Prosecutors and establishes that specific sections override other laws.

name: PUNJAB ECONOMIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016 (EXTENDED FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF 90 DAYS BY THE PAP ON 20.4.2016)

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980, specifically revising Section 5 regarding the composition of its Board. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session. The document details the new members required for the Board, including representatives from various government departments and non-official economists. Subsequently, the Provincial Assembly extended the validity of this Ordinance for a further ninety days starting April 20, 2016.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Economic Research Institute Ordinance, 1980 to re-constitute its Board. It substitutes definitions for Director, member, and Vice Chairman within the relevant section. The Act also revises Section 5 to specify the composition of the Board, including various secretaries, non-official members with specific educational requirements, and Provincial Assembly members.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Education Foundation Act 2004 to update the Board's composition and appointment procedures. It establishes a requirement for regional offices outside Lahore with approval and mandates that the Foundation follow Government directions in its functions. The Act also modifies provisions regarding vacancy filling, quorum requirements, and the determination of service terms for the Managing Director.

metadata.one_line: Regulates construction in Punjab flood plains for mitigation and development, establishing approval committees and penalties.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates construction activities within designated flood plains in the Punjab to ensure flood mitigation and water resource development. It empowers the Government to declare flood plains and appoints Canal Officers to oversee these areas and grant construction permissions through constituted committees. The legislation defines specific terms, establishes a Review Board for appeals, and prescribes offences and penalties for unauthorized construction or occupation of illegal structures.

It amends existing legislation including the Stamp Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, Entertainment Duty Act, Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and Infrastructure Development Cess Act to update tax rates and definitions. Additionally, it introduces a one-time tax on imported motor cars based on engine capacity.

amends: The Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Forensic Science Agency Act, 2007, specifically regarding the tenure of the Director General. metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Food Authority Act 2011.
repeals: The Punjab Food Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015

metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Food Authority Act 2011 regarding premises categorization, penalties, and repeals a 2015 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Food Authority Act 2011 to introduce premises categorization based on adherence to standards. It enhances punishments for selling adulterated or unsafe food, specifically targeting large-scale manufacturers with stricter penalties. The legislation also establishes mechanisms for performance reporting and monitoring by the Government, while barring civil courts from entertaining suits against proceedings under this Act.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Forest Act, 1927.
repeals: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.one_line: Amends the Forest Act, 1927 to establish forest companies for public-private partnerships on wasteland.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to facilitate better utilization of wasteland through the establishment of forest companies. It introduces provisions for public-private partnerships where the Government assigns forest land or wasteland to these companies for development and afforestation. The Act outlines the procedure for inviting eligible applicants, managing the partnership agreements, protecting forest produce, and monitoring performance by a government-appointed committee.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Forest Act, 1927.
repeals: The Punjab Forest (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016 (IX of 2016)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Forest Act, 1927 to allow conversion of reserved/protected forests for national projects with substitute land.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 to provide mechanisms for declaring reserved or protected forests no longer reserved if needed for national projects of strategic importance. It requires organizations seeking such land to provide cogent reasons, offer equal or larger substitute plantable land close to the original site, and fund immediate forestation. The Government may declare the substitute land as the new reserved or protected forest with Provincial Cabinet approval.

name: PUNJAB FOREST (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2016 (EXTENDED FOR A FURTHER PERIOD OF 90 DAYS BY THE PAP ON 24.4.2016)

metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Forest Act, 1927.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 to provide provisions for using reserved or protected forest land for national projects of strategic importance. It allows the Government, with Provincial Cabinet approval, to declare such forest land no longer reserved or protected if specific conditions regarding substitute land and afforestation are met. The Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Halal Development Agency Act, 2016

metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Halal Development Agency to regulate and promote halal trade in the province.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Halal Development Agency as a body corporate to regulate and promote the trade of halal food and non-food products within the Province. The Agency is empowered to ensure uniform Halal Standards, issue certificates, and frame regulations under the supervision of the Government of the Punjab. It defines key terms related to food, manufacturing, and accreditation, while also outlining provisions for audits, rule-making powers, and exemptions.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2001 Ordinance to empower local governments to sell or lease immovable property via public auction.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to further empower local governments regarding property management. It specifically allows local governments to sell immovable property after obtaining prior government approval and conducting a public auction. Additionally, it grants powers to lease immovable properties for up to fifteen years initially, with options to extend the lease period by ten years at a time.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Records Authority Ordinance, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of the Punjab Land Records Authority for reform and modernization of the system of land records.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize land records in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Land Records Authority to reform and modernize the system of land records within the province. It aims to improve service delivery, ensure long-lasting tenure security, and address ancillary matters related to land management. The Authority is empowered to frame policies, manage land records, establish Arazi Record Centers, and coordinate with other government departments like the Board of Revenue.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Act, 2016

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to redefine 'technocrat' and adjust reserved seats for women, peasants/workers, youth, and non-Muslims in Union, District, Municipal, and Metropolitan councils. It substitutes specific clauses regarding the election of chairmen, vice-chairmen, and deputy mayors, as well as membership numbers based on population. The Act also omits section 18A of the parent Act and repeals the Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2016.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2016

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to empower the Government to divide Metropolitan and Municipal Corporations into zones for better service delivery. It rationalizes the representation of marginalized segments by increasing the number of worker, peasant, and technocrat members in local governments. The document also updates provisions regarding the presiding officers of meetings when Mayors or Chairmen are absent and adjusts membership numbers based on population thresholds.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2016

The amendment substitutes subsection (3) of section 116 in the parent Act to align property tax levies with the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 when rates are not determined locally.

The Act also updates provisions regarding presiding officers for meetings and increases the number of Deputy Mayors and Vice Chairmen based on population.

repeals: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2016

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to align reserved seat elections with proportional representation systems used in Provincial Assemblies. It redefines a 'technocrat' based on specific educational and experience criteria and alters election methods for various local government bodies like Union Councils and Municipal Corporations. The legislation also updates procedures for filling vacant reserved seats and determines the timing of the first meeting of local governments.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to allow local governments to sell or lease immovable property with prior approval.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to empower local governments to sell immovable property through public auction after obtaining prior approval from the Government. It also grants authority to lease immovable properties for an initial period of fifteen years, extendable by ten more years, and allows the transfer of movable properties via public auction. The provisions ensure that all outstanding dues are paid before selling or leasing properties and respect the occupant's first right of refusal.

It redefines a 'technocrat' based on specific educational and experience criteria and changes election methods for various local government bodies to use open division. The document also updates provisions regarding the composition of Union Councils and the filling of vacant reserved seats.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to ensure local governments provide designated landfill sites for solid waste disposal. The Act also mandates that local governments maintain these sites according to bylaws until proper clearance is obtained from the Provincial Environmental Protection Agency.

metadata.summary: This Act regulates marriage functions and related ceremonies within the Province of Punjab. The legislation applies to all establishments within the Province of Punjab employing women on a regular or temporary basis.

metadata.summary: This Act regulates poultry production activities within the Punjab to ensure quality products and biosecurity. It mandates the registration of poultry premises and establishes a Registration Committee and Appellate Board to oversee applications and appeals. The Act defines key terms such as 'poultry farm' and 'poultry operation', outlines fees for registration, and prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines for operating without registration or violating proximity rules.

It introduces strict regulations on fee structures, requiring applications for increases at least three months in advance and limiting annual increases to five percent. The Act also mandates registration before business commencement, restricts the purchase of textbooks from specific providers, and establishes enhanced penalties for unregistered operation or contravention of rules.

The Act also substitutes the exemption section and repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance of 2015.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF CHILD LABOUR AT BRICK KILNS ACT 2016

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Prohibition of Child Labour at Brick Kilns Act, 2016
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the prohibition of child labour and regulation of labour at the brick kilns in the Punjab.
metadata.max_penalty: simple imprisonment up to six months (minimum seven days) and fine up to five hundred thousand rupees (minimum fifty thousand rupees)
metadata.one_line: Prohibits child labour and regulates working conditions at brick kilns in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children at brick kilns in the Punjab to protect their health, growth, and education. It mandates written contracts for all workers, limits cash advances (peshgi) to fifty thousand rupees, and establishes presumptions regarding child age and employment status. The legislation empowers inspectors to seal kilns and imposes strict penalties on occupiers and parents who contravene these provisions.

metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective system to protect, provide relief, and rehabilitate women against violence in the Province of Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'aggrieved person' and 'domestic violence', and mandates the Government to set up Protection Centres, shelter homes, and a toll-free number. The Act empowers Courts to issue protection, residence, and monetary orders while requiring the Government to submit annual reports on the efficacy of the protection system.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to provide for more effective law enforcement and rationalized punishments. It updates definitions for 'Director' and 'Local Authority', substitutes references to magistrates with Special Courts, and introduces new provisions regarding sealing premises and electronic evidence collection. The Act also substitutes sections dealing with selling adulterated food, manufacturing large quantities of adulterated food, substandard/misbranded food, unsafe food, and unhygienic conditions, significantly increasing penalties including imprisonment and fines.

metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children under fifteen years and restricts adolescents (15-18 years) from hazardous work. It establishes a Provincial Committee on Child Labour to advise on eradication measures and sets strict limits on working hours, rest intervals, and prohibited activities like night work. The Act also mandates occupiers to notify inspectors within thirty days of employing an adolescent and repeals the previous Employment of Children Act, 1991.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of Pakistan to update terminology from 'servants' to 'staff' and 'Commissions' to 'Commission'. It modifies Article 213 to define new criteria for appointing the Commissioner of the Election Commission, requiring them to be a Supreme Court judge, senior civil servant, or technocrat. The Act also adjusts retirement terms for Commission members, sets a timeline for filling vacancies, and expands the Commission's functions to include delimitation of local government constituencies.

It inserts a new subsection into section 25 regarding the display of these plates by owners. Additionally, it introduces section 97A which prescribes penalties for the unauthorized preparation or fabrication of number plates and screws.

It adjusts the number of reserved seats for women, peasants/workers, youth, non-Muslims, and technocrats based on population and council type. The Ordinance also modifies provisions regarding the election of Chairmen/Vice Chairmen and the performance of functions in cases of absence.

metadata.summary: This Act amends Article 175 of the Constitution of Pakistan to exclude certain terrorism-related cases from its provisions. It applies to persons belonging to terrorist groups using religion or a sect as their name, who are tried under specific Acts listed in the First Schedule. The Act remains in force for two years from its commencement date and then ceases to be part of the Constitution.

The legislation was enacted during a period of extraordinary circumstances following the Peshawar school attack and is valid for a limited period of two years.

The Act grants powers to make regulations, delegates specific functions, and deems its officers as public servants while repealing the previous Ordinance.

metadata.summary: The Punjab Information of Temporary Residents Ordinance, 2015 was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to establish a database of tenants and temporary residents. It requires landlords, hotel managers, and property dealers to provide specific information about guests and tenants to the police within strict timeframes (48 hours for tenants, 3 hours for guests). The Ordinance also mandates identification checks using national identity cards or passports and prohibits the possession of unlicensed firearms by tenants. Offenses under this law are cognizable and non-bailable, with penalties including imprisonment up to six months and fines ranging from ten thousand to one hundred thousand rupees.

metadata.summary: The Punjab Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2015 establishes a levy of 0.90% on the total value of goods moving within or through the Punjab. The collected funds are deposited into the Provincial Consolidated Fund to support infrastructure maintenance and development. The Act applies to manufacturers, producers, consumers, importers, and exporters, with specific payment mechanisms mirroring customs duties or sales tax depending on the origin of the goods.

It addresses discrepancies in the establishment or composition of the Punjab Revenue Authority and validates actions taken by the Chairperson before the full establishment of the Authority. metadata.short_title: The Punjab Safe Cities Authority Ordinance, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of Punjab Safe Cities Authority.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Punjab Safe Cities Authority to construct, develop, and maintain an integrated command, control, and communications (IC3) system. It applies to the city of Lahore and other cities specified by the Government within the whole of Punjab. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to acquire property, enter contracts, and oversee security infrastructure, while its employees are deemed public servants.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Pure Food (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960.

metadata.one_line: Amends the 1960 Ordinance to strengthen enforcement, update definitions, and increase penalties for food adulteration.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to ensure more effective law enforcement and rationalize punishments. It updates key definitions such as 'Director' and 'Local Authority', substitutes 'Special Court' for magistrates in certain sections, and introduces new offences regarding substandard, misbranded, and unsafe food. The document also expands the powers of inspectors to seal premises and use electronic devices for evidence generation while increasing fines and imprisonment terms for large-scale manufacturers.

name: PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ACT, 2015

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for effective security arrangements of vulnerable establishments.
repeals: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 1999
The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment which may extend to six months and fine which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees but shall not exceed one hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for effective security arrangements in vulnerable establishments to prevent terrorism and other crimes.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015 establishes a framework for securing vulnerable places such as hospitals, banks, and religious sites. It creates a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying these establishments, inspecting them quarterly, and issuing security advice to managers. The Act empowers the District Coordination Officer to maintain lists of vulnerable establishments and imposes penalties on those who fail to comply with security arrangements or provide evidence during investigations.

name: PUNJAB SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ORDINANCE, 2015

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for effective security arrangements of vulnerable establishments.
repeals: The Punjab Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 1999
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment which may extend to six months and fine which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees but shall not exceed one hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Ordinance establishes security committees and procedures to protect vulnerable establishments in Punjab from terrorism and crime.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015 was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab to ensure effective security arrangements for various sensitive locations. It establishes a Security Advisory Committee in each sub-division to identify vulnerable establishments, inspect them quarterly, and issue necessary security advice. The Ordinance defines 'vulnerable establishments' broadly to include places of worship, government offices, banks, hospitals, schools, hotels, and commercial centers. It repeals the Punjab Shops and Establishments (Security) Act, 1999, and prescribes penalties for non-compliance with security directives or failure to provide evidence obtained through installed security systems.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Social Protection Authority Act, 2015

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Social Protection Authority as a body corporate to provide a comprehensive social protection system for the poor and vulnerable in the province. The Authority consists of high-ranking government officials, civil society representatives, and assembly members tasked with formulating policy and coordinating efforts with federal and international institutions. It repeals the previous Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970, and the interim Punjab Social Protection Authority Ordinance, 2015, transferring their assets, liabilities, and employees to the new Authority.

The Authority is responsible for formulating social protection policies, consolidating public sector initiatives, and protecting vulnerable groups against livelihood risks. It consists of high-ranking government officials, Assembly members, civil society representatives, and co-opted experts, with powers to make rules and regulations.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act, 2015

metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Province of Punjab to prevent public nuisance, maintain public order, and protect the environment. It prohibits the use of loudspeakers that generate unnecessary noise or disturb specific locations like hospitals, educational institutions, and places of worship during prayer times. The Act empowers police officers to inspect sound systems, seize equipment used in offences, and imposes penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Province of Punjab to prevent public nuisance, disorder, and environmental harm. It prohibits loud or unnecessary noise that disturbs persons near places of worship, hospitals, educational institutions, and residential areas. The law empowers police officers to inspect sound systems, seize equipment used in offences, and imposes penalties including imprisonment and fines for violations.

The Unit is headed by a Director and consists of various ranks ranging from Chief Security Officer to Security Constable, recruited specifically for this role without transfer to the general executive branch. It outlines the functions of the Unit, terms of service, fees for services provided to private or public organizations, recruitment criteria, age limits for retirement, and administrative control under the Provincial Police Officer.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to incorporate modern electronic stamping mechanisms. It defines 'e-stamp' as paper containing a bar code or unique identification code generated upon deposit of equivalent money. The Act also updates definitions regarding impressed labels and instruments executed in electronic form, while adding a new section for officers to issue certificates on the genuineness of e-stamps for legal proceedings.

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bab-e-Pakistan Foundation as a body corporate to replace the dysfunctional Bab-e-Pakistan Trust. The Foundation is empowered to construct and maintain national memorials for those who sacrificed their lives at the time of Pakistan's creation, promote national arts and culture, and organize cultural events. It creates a Board of Governors managed by the Government of the Punjab, which has the authority to make rules and frame regulations. Upon establishment, the original Bab-e-Pakistan Trust is dissolved, with its assets and liabilities transferred to the new Foundation.

metadata.one_line: Establishes the Government Sadiq College Women University Bahawalpur and defines its structure, functions, and governance.

It outlines the university's composition, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils like the Syndicate and Academic Council. The legislation details the university's functions in education and research, its financial provisions including a dedicated fund, and mechanisms for appeals and indemnity.

metadata.short_title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 by substituting 'metropolitan area of Lahore' with 'area of Lahore Division' in the preamble and extending the Act's extension to Lahore Division. It defines various terms related to land, housing schemes, and agencies within the authority. The Act also establishes a Commission to consider recommendations on bona fide purchases, illegal schemes, and illegally constructed structures, with appeals lying to the Lahore High Court.

metadata.short_title: The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975.
metadata.parent_law: The Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
metadata.one_line: Amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to expand its jurisdiction to Lahore Division and define terms.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 to extend the Authority's jurisdiction from the metropolitan area of Lahore to the entire area of Lahore Division. It substitutes specific sections in the parent Act to reflect this change and updates definitions related to land, agencies, and local government. The document also establishes a Commission to handle matters regarding illegal transactions, schemes, and structures within the division.

metadata.short_title: Notification No. PA:4-4/2013/1122
metadata.one_line: Terminates the office of all Parliamentary Secretaries in Punjab following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.
metadata.summary: This notification declares that all Parliamentary Secretaries in the Punjab cease to hold office. The action is taken consequent upon the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly on March 20, 2013. It serves as an official record of the termination of their tenure.

metadata.short_title: Order dissolving the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
metadata.parent_law: Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan
metadata.one_line: Order dissolving the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab with immediate effect.
metadata.summary: This Order was made by the Governor of the Punjab under Clause (1) of Article 112 of the Constitution. It dissolves the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab with immediate effect. The order was issued on the advice of the Chief Minister of Punjab and is published for general information.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2013

repeals: The Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
establishes: medical and other institutions (via public-private partnership)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to update benefits, wages, and establish medical institutions in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965 to align wage limits with government determinations and restrict its application to the Province of Punjab. It updates various sections regarding survivor pensions, funeral grants, and medical care benefits for secured persons. Additionally, it empowers the Institution to establish medical and allied health institutions through public-private partnerships.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963.
amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 by redefining 'animal' to include specific halal domesticated species.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 to update the definition of 'animal'. The amendment substitutes a new clause in section 2 of the 1963 Act. The new definition includes bulls, bullocks, buffaloes, camels, cows, goats, ostriches, sheep, and any other halal animal domesticated in captivity. The Act came into force immediately upon publication.

name: MUHAMMAD NAWAZ SHAREEF UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE MULTAN ACT, 2013

metadata.short_title: The Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan.
establishes: Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan
metadata.one_line: Establishes Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan and provides for its governance, functions, and financial provisions.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Muhammad Nawaz Shareef University of Agriculture Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's functions, including providing education in agriculture and other branches, conducting research, and awarding degrees. The Act defines various bodies such as the Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and sets out financial provisions for the University Fund and budget management.

name: PUNJAB BOILERS AND PRESSURE VESSELS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Boilers and Pressure Vessels (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance 2002.
establishes: Provincial Boilers and Pressure Vessels Safety Board
metadata.one_line: Amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance 2002 to transfer jurisdiction from Federal to Provincial authorities.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Boilers and Pressure Vessels Ordinance 2002 to shift regulatory authority from the Federal Government to the Government of the Punjab. It substitutes references to 'Federal' with 'Punjab' throughout the Ordinance and limits the Ordinance's application to specific types of boilers within the province. The Act establishes a Provincial Boilers and Pressure Vessels Safety Board and an Ad hoc Technical Committee to oversee safety regulations, licensing, and enforcement within Punjab.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Second Amendment) Act, 2012

amends: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 to expand housing benefits. It inserts 'plots' into the preamble and defines 'house' to include flats or quarters while defining 'plot' as a residential plot. The Act also substitutes terms in various sections regarding housing schemes, membership termination procedures, and payment obligations.

name: PUNJAB HOUSING AND TOWN PLANNING AGENCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency (Amendment) Act, 2012

amends: The Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance, 2002
key_definitions: absorption in the service of the Agency
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2002 Ordinance to clarify government servant status and delegate disciplinary powers within the Agency.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Housing and Town-Planning Agency Ordinance 2002 to address the employment status of government servants serving in the Agency. It clarifies that such employees remain Government employees unless absorbed into the Agency's service and allows for the delegation of disciplinary, administrative, and financial powers regarding their terms and conditions.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to levy, alter and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: on the first day of July 2013 except specific provisions which shall come into force on the first day of January 2014 or on such date as the Government may specify
amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
repeals: section 9 of The Punjab Finance Act, 1972
metadata.one_line: An Act to levy, alter and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act levies, alters, and rationalizes various taxes, fees, and duties within the Punjab province. It amends several existing acts related to urban immovable property tax, entertainments duty, motor vehicles taxation, agricultural income tax, and previous finance acts. The legislation introduces a capital gains tax on immovable property and establishes specific rules for luxury tax on residential houses owned by widows.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to streamline partition proceedings and set time limits for decisions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967 to facilitate private partition of joint holdings in cases of inheritance. It mandates revenue officers to serve notices for partition schemes within thirty days and sets a strict time limit of one hundred and eighty days for deciding partition cases. The legislation also introduces provisions for handling title disputes during partition and imposes disciplinary liability on officers who fail to meet these timelines.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to grant additional taxation powers to local governments.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to provide additional powers for taxation and fees. It allows the Government to prescribe taxes or fees not specifically listed in the Second Schedule, recoverable by the Local Government. The Act also validates certain levies made prior to its commencement that did not strictly follow procedural requirements.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 regarding election procedures and non-Muslim representation.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to facilitate immediate legislative action while the Provincial Assembly is not in session. It modifies sections concerning Union Councils, District Councils, Municipal Corporations, and Municipal Committees to adjust membership composition for non-Muslim representatives. The amendments also update provisions related to election schedules, polling station lists, and the appointment of returning officers by the Election Commission.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
repeals: the Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance 2013 (VI of 2013)
the Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance 2013 (VII of 2013)
the Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance 2013 (VII of 2013)
the Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance 2013 (IX of 2013)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 regarding ward delimitation, reserved seats, and election procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to define wards within Union Councils and Municipal Committees. It establishes rules for delimiting wards for general and reserved seats, including specific provisions for women, peasant/worker, youth, and non-Muslim members. The Act also inserts a section on the finality of delimitation, preventing judicial review after the election schedule is notified, and substitutes sections regarding the composition of local government bodies and franchise requirements.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 regarding election franchise, delimitation finality, and section text corrections.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to remove specific wording from Section 8 and correct punctuation in Section 27. It substitutes Section 18 to establish that elections for local governments shall be held through secret ballot on the basis of adult franchise. Additionally, it inserts a new Section 10A stating that courts or authorities cannot review delimitation after the election schedule is notified.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 regarding ward definitions, union council composition, and election procedures.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act, 2013 to define a 'ward' within Union Councils or Municipal Committees. It introduces specific provisions for delimiting wards for general seats and reserved seats for women, peasants/workers, youth, and non-Muslim members. The text also substitutes sections regarding Union Council composition, polling station establishment, voter enrollment criteria, and procedures for filling vacancies in elected offices.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Local Government Act 2013.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab, Law and Parliamentary Affairs Department
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to add a Muslim candidate declaration and emergency publication powers.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Local Government Act 2013 to insert a requirement for Muslim candidates to submit a specific declaration of faith regarding the finality of Prophethood. It also grants the government power to dispense with previous publication requirements in emergencies. Additionally, it adds a Ninth Schedule containing the text of the required declaration.

name: PUNJAB MINIMUM WAGES FOR UNSKILLED WORKERS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969.
amends: Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969
metadata.one_line: Amends the Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969 to apply specifically to the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages for Unskilled Workers Ordinance, 1969 to restrict its application to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to Pakistan and West Pakistan with the Punjab, inserts 'Punjab' before Minimum Wages, and redefines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab. The Act also expands the definition of 'industrial area' to include specific districts like Faisalabad, Lahore, Multan, and Sheikhupura, while empowering the Government to amend the Schedule without reducing existing minimum wages.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Motion Pictures (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Motion Pictures Ordinance 1979.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Motion Pictures Ordinance 1979 to apply provincial laws and establish a Film Censor Board in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 to adapt it for the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to Federal or Provincial Governments with 'Government' (meaning Government of the Punjab) and changes 'Pakistan' to 'the Punjab'. The Act establishes a Punjab Film Censor Board consisting of a Chairman, Vice Chairman, and up to ten members to examine and certify films. It also empowers authorized officers to seize exhibiting materials if police are unavailable and expands the definition of 'place' to include transport.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment), Act 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Police Order, 2002.
repeals: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance 2013 (II of 2013)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Police Order 2002 regarding police recruitment, investigation separation, and departmental promotions in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Order, 2002 to regulate police recruitment based on domicile and rank. It establishes the separation of investigation functions from general police duties by creating District Investigation Branches with specific ranks and supervisory structures. The legislation also details the composition of Standing Boards for case transfers and omits certain previous articles.

name: PUNJAB PARTITION OF IMMOVABLE PORPERTY ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Partition of Immovable Property Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend and reform the law relating to partition of immovable property.
repeals: The Partition Act, 1893 (IV of 1893)
key_definitions: Court (Court of original jurisdiction competent to entertain and decide suits for partition of immovable property)
immovable property (immovable property, other than agricultural land or land subservient to agriculture, jointly owned by two or more persons)
internal auction (auction of the immovable property amongst the co-owners of the property in which at least two co-owners are eligible to participate)
mesne profits (the approximate rental benefit which the co-owner in possession of the immovable property gains to the exclusion of any other co-owner during the pendency of the suit under the Act)
metadata.one_line: An Act to amend and reform the law relating to the expeditious partition of non-agricultural immovable property in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends and reforms the law regarding the partition of immovable property within the Province of Punjab. It applies specifically to jointly owned non-agricultural land, excluding agricultural land from its scope. The legislation establishes procedures for filing suits, serving notices, handling defaulting defendants via ex-parte orders, calculating mesne profits, appointing referees, and conducting internal auctions.

name: PUNJAB PROTECTION AGAINST HARASSMENT OF WOMEN AT THE WORKPLACE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace (Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection Against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010. It substitutes the term 'Ombudsperson' for 'Ombudsman' throughout the law and updates various sections to reflect changes in industrial relations acts and government definitions. The Act also modifies qualifications for the Ombudsperson and establishes a final decision-making process involving the Governor.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2013

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to include women from public or private sectors as eligible candidates. It also changes the term of office for members to three years with restrictions on reappointment and allows for a Chairman appointment during the residual period of a member's term.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Police Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Order, 2002 to regulate police recruitment based on domicile and rank. It establishes the separation of investigation functions from other police duties by creating District Investigation Branches with specific ranks and supervisory structures. The text also details procedures for departmental promotions via the Punjab Public Service Commission and defines various standing boards for review and transfer of cases.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 regarding composition, appointment, removal, and financial powers.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 to update provisions concerning the composition of Tribunals and the qualifications for their Chairman and Members. It introduces new procedures for appointing officials, establishes financial autonomy for the Tribunal's Chairman, and outlines the process for removing officials due to misconduct or incapacity. The Act also inserts sections regarding appeals to the Lahore High Court and omits certain previous sections and schedules.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 regarding tribunal composition, tenure, removal, and financial powers.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Service Tribunals Act, 1974 to update the qualifications and tenure of Tribunal Chairmen and Members. It establishes new rules for constituting benches, introduces provisions for the removal of officials due to misconduct or incapacity, and grants the Chairman financial powers as the Principal Accounting Officer. The Ordinance also omits certain previous sections and schedules while providing a transition mechanism to review incumbent members.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance 1970.
amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance 1970 by substituting 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' in section 4.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on January 12, 2013. The amendment substitutes the word 'Chief Minister' for the word 'Governor' in sub-section (2) of section 4 of the Ordinance. The Act came into force at once upon publication.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ACT 2013

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for transparency and freedom of information in the Punjab
repeals: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Ordinance (IV of 2013)
metadata.one_line: Establishes a framework for transparency and freedom of information in the Punjab, creating an Information Commission.
metadata.summary: This Act provides for transparency and freedom of information within the Province of Punjab to ensure citizens have improved access to public information. It establishes the Punjab Information Commission to oversee requests for information and handle complaints regarding denial or mishandling of such requests. The Act mandates proactive disclosure by public bodies and defines 'public body' broadly to include government departments, local governments, courts, and substantially financed non-government organizations.

name: PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Ordinance, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for transparency and freedom of information in the Punjab.
metadata.one_line: Establishes a framework for transparency and freedom of information in the Punjab, creating an Information Commission.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for transparency and freedom of information to ensure citizens have improved access to public information in the Punjab. It establishes the Punjab Information Commission to oversee requests, handle complaints regarding wrongful denial or delays, and enforce proactive disclosure by public bodies. The law defines 'public body' broadly to include government departments, local governments, courts, and NGOs substantially financed by the state, while granting applicants the right to inspect documents and obtain copies.

name: PUNJAB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES (INTERNATIONAL SYSTEM) ENFORCEMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT 2013

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement (Amendment) Act, 2013

metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1975 Punjab Weights and Measures Act by adding definitions and penalties for forgery.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Weights and Measures (International System) Enforcement Act, 1975 to include new definitions for calibration, counterfeit, repairer, and seal. It substitutes section 19 of the parent Act to prescribe stricter penalties for forging stamps, using false instruments fraudulently, possessing false instruments with intent, selling deficient goods, and committing repeat offenses. The amendments also expand the scope of activities subject to regulation by including 'repairing' alongside manufacturing and selling.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Workmen's Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to update compensation limits and definitions for the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923 to specifically apply it to the Province of Punjab. It updates compensation amounts for death, permanent disablement, and temporary disablement, revises the definition of 'Provincial Government', and adjusts penalties related to false claims. The amendments also omit certain sections and clauses from the original 1923 Act that are no longer applicable or require revision.

metadata.short_title: The Women University Multan (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Women University Multan Act 2010.
key_definitions: Government Postgraduate College for Women Multan
metadata.one_line: Amends the Women University Multan Act 2010 to reconstitute a college as a university and define its structure.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Women University Multan Act 2010 to formally reconstitute the Government Postgraduate College for Women Multan as the Women University Multan. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its governing structure, including roles such as Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Authority members. The legislation also addresses the transfer of property and the absorption or deputation status of existing government employees into the new university service.

metadata.short_title: The Antiquities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Antiquities Act 1975.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Antiquities Act 1975 to apply provincial jurisdiction and establish an Advisory Committee in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Antiquities Act, 1975 to replace references to Pakistan with the Punjab and Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It establishes an Advisory Committee chaired by the Director General for antiquity protection and modifies provisions regarding land acquisition for antiquities. The amendments also redefine 'export' to mean taking items out of the Punjab and omit section 38 of the original Act.

metadata.short_title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XI of 1989).
repeals: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance 2011
metadata.one_line: Amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to make the Government a shareholder and repeals the 2011 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to establish the Government as a shareholder capable of holding up to eighty percent of the bank's shares. It substitutes section 7 of the 1989 Act with new provisions regarding government shareholding. The Act also repeals the earlier Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance 2011.

metadata.short_title: The Administrator General's (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Administrator General's Act, 1913.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Administrator General's Act, 1913 to update definitions and procedures for estate administration in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Administrator General's Act, 1913 to align it with current constitutional and legal frameworks in Punjab. It updates specific sections regarding the appointment of the Administrator General, jurisdictional limits, and asset valuation thresholds. The amendments also modernize references by substituting older acts with newer ordinances and removing obsolete provincial designations.

metadata.short_title: The Charitable and Religious Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920.
amends: The Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920
metadata.one_line: Amends the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 regarding its extension to Punjab and definitions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Charitable and Religious Trusts Act, 1920 by extending its application to the whole of the Punjab. It substitutes Section 1 to clarify territorial extent and Section 2 to define 'Court' and 'Government'. The Act came into force immediately upon deemed assent.

metadata.short_title: The Defamation (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Defamation Ordinance, 2002.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Defamation Ordinance, 2002 to extend jurisdiction to Punjab and redefine terms.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Defamation Ordinance, 2002 to ensure it extends to the whole of the Punjab. It updates definitions within the Ordinance to specify that 'Government' refers to the Government of the Punjab and provides a detailed definition for 'newspaper'. Additionally, the Act omits the word 'Federal' from Section 16 of the Ordinance, thereby aligning the law with provincial jurisdiction.

metadata.short_title: The Constitution (Twentieth Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
amends: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Constitution of Pakistan to further regulate the appointment of care-taker Prime Ministers and Chief Ministers. It inserts new provisions regarding the formation of committees by Speakers of National and Provincial Assemblies to finalize appointments when political parties cannot agree. The amendments also update references to the Election Commission throughout various articles concerning elections and administrative roles.

metadata.short_title: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Disabled Persons (Employment & Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981.

amends: The Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disabled Persons (Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 to transfer administrative powers from national/federal entities to the Government of the Punjab. It establishes a Provincial Council comprising various government department representatives and trade union members to oversee employment and rehabilitation projects. The amendments redefine key terms like 'Government' and 'Chairman' to reflect provincial jurisdiction, adjust reservation percentages for disabled persons, and delegate specific functions to the newly constituted Provincial Council.

name: DISPOSAL OF LAND BY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES (REGULATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

amends: The Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1998 Act to update land disposal quotas for various groups including defence, police, and minorities.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation) Act, 1998 to revise the manner and percentages of land allotment. It specifically updates Section 2 to define Development Authorities and Section 4 to adjust disposal quotas for plots of different sizes. The amendments allocate specific percentages for defence personnel, police, government servants, minorities, and destitutes through various methods like auction or ballot.

name: EVACUEE PROPERTY AND DISPLACED PERSONS LAWS (REPEAL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) (Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Evacuee Property and Displaced Persons Laws (Repeal) Act, 1975 to update terminology regarding the Government of the Punjab and the Board of Revenue. It inserts new definitions for 'Board of Revenue' and 'Government' and modifies sections concerning property disposal and jurisdiction. The amendments ensure that references to provincial bodies align with current administrative structures in Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Factories (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Factories Act 1934.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Factories Act 1934 to update penalties, definitions, and applicability within Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Factories Act 1934 to align it with provincial jurisdiction by replacing references to 'Provincial' and 'Pakistan' with 'Punjab'. It updates various sections regarding fines, penalties for previous convictions, and the definition of government-controlled factories. The amendments also substitute older child employment acts with newer legislation and extend the Act's application to all factories, including those owned or controlled by the Federal Government.

metadata.short_title: The Hindu Disposition of Property (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916.
amends: The Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Disposition of Property Act, 1916 to restrict its application to the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' and 'the Province' with 'the Punjab' and defines 'Government' as the Government of the Punjab. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration following a return for review.

metadata.short_title: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928.
amends: The Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Hindu Inheritance (Removal of Disabilities) Act, 1928 to apply specifically to the Province of Punjab. It achieves this by substituting the word 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in subsection (2) of section 1 of the parent Act. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received deemed assent from the Governor under Article 116(3) of the Constitution on February 11, 2012.

metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Hindu Law of Inheritance (Amendment) Act, 1929. It specifically substitutes the word 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in subsection (2) of section 1 of the 1929 Act. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab after reconsideration and deemed assent under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

name: GHAZI UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan.
metadata.one_line: Establishes Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan by reconstituting existing colleges and defining its structure.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan by reconstituting several existing government colleges and medical institutes into a single university body. It defines the university's corporate status, organizational structure including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines the transfer of property and staff from the constituent institutions. The Act also provides for financial provisions, including the creation of a University Fund, budget approval by the Syndicate, and mechanisms for appeals and indemnity for officials acting in good faith.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2004 to align its provisions with the provincial context of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in section 1 and redefines 'Government' to mean specifically the Government of the Punjab. Additionally, it grants the Government power to make rules for carrying out the purposes of the Act.

name: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY OF THE PUNJAB ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Information Technology University of the Punjab Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Information Technology University of the Punjab and to deal with ancillary matters.
establishes: Information Technology University of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Information Technology University of the Punjab in Lahore with powers to educate, research, and manage funds.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Information Technology University of the Punjab as a body corporate located in Lahore. It grants the University powers to provide education in information technology, conduct research, award degrees, and maintain constituent colleges and institutes. The Act also sets up financial provisions including a University Fund, defines the composition of the Syndicate and other authorities, and outlines procedures for appeals and removal of difficulties.

metadata.short_title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2012

amends: The King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act, 2005

metadata.summary: This Act amends the King Edward Medical University, Lahore Act 2005 to update provisions related to the Vice Chancellor and Pro-Vice Chancellor. It establishes a Search Committee for selecting the Vice Chancellor, limits the tenure of the Vice Chancellor, and clarifies the powers and functions of the Chancellor and Syndicate. The amendments also address emergency actions by the Vice Chancellor and nomination procedures for the Pro-Vice Chancellor.

metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Official Trustees Act, 1913.
metadata.parent_law: The Official Trustees Act, 1913

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Official Trustees Act, 1913 to ensure it extends to the whole of Punjab. It substitutes specific clauses regarding territorial extent, commencement, and the definition of 'Government' to refer specifically to the Government of the Punjab. The Act also omits section 3 of the original 1913 Act and updates references to the Province as Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 to substitute references to 'Provincial Government' with 'Government of the Punjab'. It updates various sections regarding jurisdiction, industrial relations laws, penalty amounts, and court designations. The amendments come into force immediately upon publication.

It substitutes the words 'one thousand rupees' with 'twenty thousand rupees' in Section 11 of the said Act. The amendment was passed by the Provincial Assembly on February 28, 2012, and received assent from the Governor on March 7, 2012. It came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Insolvency (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920 to replace references to Karachi Division and Provincial Government with Punjab-specific terms.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920 to align its provisions specifically with the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to 'outside the Karachi Division' with 'in the Punjab', changes 'Provincial Government' to 'Government', and restricts judicial references from 'High Courts' to the 'Lahore High Court'. The Act also updates definitions for District Courts and local authorities, and omits Section 82 of the original Act.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012

motor vehicle constructed for the carriage of not more than six passengers

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to include buses operated under the Punjab Metrobus Authority within specific definitions. It also clarifies the definition of trailers used for purposes other than goods carriage or hire/reward when drawn by vehicles carrying not more than six passengers. The amendments are enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and come into force on a date specified by government notification.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance 1965.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance 1965 to update the list of traffic violations and their corresponding fines. It substitutes the Twelfth Schedule of the Ordinance with a detailed table listing specific offenses, such as speeding, overloading, and using mobile phones while driving, alongside applicable fines for motorcycles, cars, jeeps, and public service vehicles. The Act came into force immediately upon its publication in the Gazette.

metadata.short_title: The Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Parks and Horticulture Authority in the Punjab.

metadata.one_line: Establishes the Parks and Horticulture Authority in Lahore to regulate parks, green belts, and outdoor advertisements.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Parks and Horticulture Authority for the district of Lahore to regulate, develop, and maintain public parks and green areas. It empowers the Authority to control billboards and sky signs, promote horticulture, and acquire land for park development. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to manage property and sue or be sued, operating under the supervision of the Government of the Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Pesticides (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 (II of 1971).
metadata.parent_law: The Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971
metadata.one_line: Amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to shift jurisdiction and powers from Federal to Provincial level in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971 to replace references to the Federal Government with the Government of the Punjab. It substitutes 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab' in specific sections and redefines the Committee composition to include officers of the Government or persons representing trade and industry. The Act also delegates powers to subordinate officers and clarifies that 'Government' refers specifically to the Government of the Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the laws of agricultural universities in the Punjab.
amends: The University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
The Pir Mehr Ali Shah Arid Agriculture University, Rawalpindi Act, 1995
