metadata.summary: This Act amends the laws relating to agricultural universities in the Punjab, specifically focusing on the roles of Pro-Chancellor and Vice Chancellor. It establishes procedures for appointing Vice Chancellors through a Search Committee, sets age limits, and defines the functions of the Pro-Vice Chancellor. The amendments apply to existing university acts from 1973 and 1995.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963.
amends: The Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
key_definitions: animal (as amended in section 2 of the Act III of 1963)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 by redefining 'animal' to include specific domesticated species.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963. It specifically revises the definition of 'animal' in section 2 of the 1963 Act. The amendment expands the list of animals to include buffalo-bull, camel, cow, goat, sheep, ostrich, and other domesticated animals in captivity.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Bonded Labour System (Abolition) (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1992 to align its provisions specifically with the Government of the Punjab. It substitutes 'Pakistan' with 'the Punjab', replaces 'District Magistrate' with 'District Coordination Officer', and omits references to Federal Governments or Departments throughout the text. The amendments also adjust specific numerical values regarding fines and penalties within the original 1992 Act.

metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to repeal the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Gujranwala) Ordinance, 1963. It received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011, and was published in the Gazette on January 3, 2012. The Act comes into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to repeal the Punjab Bus Stands and Traffic Control (Lahore) Ordinance, 1963. It received assent from the Governor on December 31, 2011, and came into force immediately upon publication. The legislation applies specifically to Lahore within the province of Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 regarding promotion approval for deceased or superannuated civil servants.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 to address a specific scenario involving civil servant promotions. It inserts a new subsection into Section 8 of the 1974 Act. The amendment allows the competent authority to approve promotion for a civil servant who dies or superannuates after being recommended for a higher post but before assuming charge. If this occurs, the promotion is approved with effect from the day immediately before the date of death or superannuation.

name: PUNJAB CONFERMENT OF PROPRIETARY RIGHTS ON OCCUPANCY TENANTS AND MUQARRARIDARS ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Conferment of Proprietary Rights on Occupancy Tenants and Mugarraridars Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to confer proprietary rights on occupancy tenants and muqarraridars.
metadata.one_line: This Act confers ownership rights on occupancy tenants and muqarraridars in Punjab by entering their names in revenue records.
metadata.summary: The Act confers proprietary rights on occupancy tenants and muqarraridars regarding land they occupy, aligning with Islamic injunctions. It mandates that the Revenue Officer enter the tenant's name as the owner in the revenue record, subject to a specific remedy for landlords claiming prior cultivation rights. The provisions override other laws and allow the Government to make rules for implementation.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Court of Wards (Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Court of Wards Act 1903 to update references from 'Provincial Government' to 'Government'. It substitutes Section 3 to define key terms like 'immovable property', 'Collector', and 'ward', and replaces Section 54 regarding the Board of Revenue's power to make rules. The amendments apply throughout the Province of Punjab and came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Public Sector Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the statutes of various public sector universities in the Punjab to update appointment procedures for Vice Chancellors. It establishes a Search Committee with specific terms and criteria, sets age limits for candidates, and defines the roles of Pro-Vice Chancellors. The amendments also validate appointments made prior to the Act's commencement.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Employees Efficiency, Discipline and Accountability Act, 2006 to update specific clauses within Section 2. It revises the definition of a member of a civil service of the province by excluding certain court employees and adding police employees as distinct categories. The amendment clarifies which judicial roles are included or excluded from specific service definitions.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 to adapt it for the Province of Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government and National standards with those of the Government of the Punjab and Punjab-specific standards. The Act establishes a Punjab Environmental Protection Council and a Provincial Environmental Protection Agency, while also delegating powers to local councils and authorities.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Curriculum Authority Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Curriculum Authority to oversee curricula, textbooks, and educational standards within the Punjab. The Authority is a body corporate comprising government secretaries, university representatives, and education professionals with powers to frame regulations and manage funds. It includes provisions for member appointments, disqualifications, delegation of powers, and mechanisms for appeals and annual reporting to the Provincial Assembly.

The amendment substitutes subsection (4) of section 17 to require that all payments made by a member be updated annually.

The Act also updates financial thresholds in section 7 and omits section 10 of the original Ordinance.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act 1992 by updating a specific figure in section 6. The amendment substitutes the year 2011 for 2006 within subsection (1) of that section. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and deemed assented to under Article 116(3) of the Constitution.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001.

It establishes an Ad hoc Accounts Committee for local governments in districts pending elections and substitutes references from Executive District Officers (Revenue) to District Coordination Officers throughout the Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to specify a timeline for holding local government elections. It requires the Government to notify a date for elections within two hundred and forty days. The amendment was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Acting Governor.

Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 (XXXII of 1958)

metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws relating to taxes and duties in the Punjab. It updates provisions in the Stamp Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and previous Finance Acts. The amendments cover changes to stamp duty on partition instruments, late payment surcharges, vehicle registration fees, capital value tax definitions, and club cess levies.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2012

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by inserting a new subsection into section 179-A. The amendment empowers the Government to change the boundaries of a union, tehsil, or town through a published notification. Such boundary changes take effect from the date of the notification.

The Act also increases maternity leave from ten days to one hundred days and raises the wage limit for eligibility from five hundred to three thousand rupees, while omitting section 15 of the original Ordinance.

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Protection of Breast-feeding and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 to align its provisions with the provincial jurisdiction of Punjab. It substitutes references to the Federal Government and Pakistan with the Government of the Punjab and the Punjab respectively. The Act also establishes the Punjab Infant Feeding Board, defines its composition and functions, and omits various sections related to Provincial Committees.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICE ACT, 2007 (REPEAL) ACT, 2012

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (Repeal) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (XIV of 2007).
repeals: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act, 2007
metadata.status_evidence: The Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 (XIV of 2007) is hereby repealed.
metadata.one_line: This Act repeals the Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007 effective immediately.
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to repeal the Punjab Public Defender Service Act 2007. The legislation was originally sent to the Governor for assent but was returned for reconsideration. After being passed again by the Assembly, it received deemed assent under Article 116(3) of the Constitution because the Governor did not assent within ten days. The Act comes into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
amends: The Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978

metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 to update the composition and appointment criteria for the Commission. It specifies that members must be appointed by the Governor, sets age limits at sixty-five years, and defines requirements for membership including experience in various professional fields. The Act also establishes fixed three-year terms for members and allows for resignation, while omitting a specific section from the original Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Metrobus Authority Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Punjab Metrobus Authority.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Metrobus Authority to construct, operate, and maintain a mass transit system in Punjab cities.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Metrobus Authority to manage the construction, operation, and maintenance of a mass transit system in major cities of the Punjab. It defines the composition of the Authority, including the Chief Minister as Chairman and various government officials, and outlines its powers regarding property acquisition and disposal. The legislation also provides for the establishment of a fund, sets out rules for service providers, and grants immunity to the Authority and its employees acting in good faith.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Punjab Revenue Authority.
metadata.commencement: on such date as the Government may, by notification, specify
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Revenue Authority to reform taxation and promote compliance.

It also establishes the role of an Ombudsman and outlines procedures for filing formal or informal complaints, ensuring a safe work environment free from sexual advances or hostile attitudes.

metadata.short_title: The Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
amends: The Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
repeals: The Legal Framework Order, 2002
The Legal Framework (Amendment) Order, 2002
The Legal Framework (Second Amendment) Order, 2002
The Constitution (Seventeenth Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.max_penalty: high treason
metadata.one_line: Amends the Constitution of Pakistan to restore democracy, federalism, and fundamental rights while repealing previous emergency laws.
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to restore democratic principles and federal structure. It declares the Legal Framework Orders of 2002 as having no legal effect and repeals the Seventeenth Amendment Act, 2003. The legislation introduces new fundamental rights including fair trial, freedom of association, right to information, and free education, while also modifying provisions related to political parties and the judiciary.

name: PUNJAB DAANISH SCHOOLS AND CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE AUTHORITY ACT 2010

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment and management of the Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence in the Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Education Authority Ordinance, 1999
establishes: Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority to manage schools in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Daanish Schools and Centers of Excellence Authority to provide quality education to underprivileged segments of society in the Punjab. The Authority is a body corporate empowered to establish schools, prescribe courses, award scholarships, and manage student welfare including hostels. It repeals the Punjab Education Authority Ordinance, 1999.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Examination Commission Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to establish a Commission for improving the examination system of elementary education.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Examination Commission to improve elementary education examinations and related systems.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Examination Commission as a body corporate to improve the examination system for elementary education. The Commission is responsible for designing, implementing, and monitoring examination systems, formulating policies, collecting research data, and advising the Government on relevant matters. It consists of members nominated by the Government, including representatives from the Provincial Assembly, Education Department, University of Education, and various sectors like banking and IT. The Act also provides for the establishment of a Fund, rules for financial management, annual auditing by the Auditor General and Chartered Accountants, and the submission of annual reports to the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to levy tax: and alter the rate oft taxes and duties in the Punjab
metadata.one_line: An Act to levy taxes, alter tax rates in Punjab, and amend related revenue laws.
metadata.summary: This Act levies taxes and alters the rates of taxes and duties within the Province of Punjab. It amends several existing statutes including the Stamp Act, 1899, the Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1967, the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989, and the Punjab Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000. The legislation establishes new stamp duty calculations for immovable property, sets mutation fee scales, increases the authorized capital of the Bank of Punjab, and updates sales tax rates on specific services.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Healthcare Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to improve quality off healthcare services and ban quackery in the Punjab in all its forms and manifestations.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Healthcare Commission to improve healthcare quality and ban quackery in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Healthcare Commission to oversee and improve the quality of healthcare services within the province. It aims to ban quackery in all its forms by regulating healthcare establishments, including hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. The legislation provides for the accreditation of facilities, licensing of service providers, and the setting of standards for patient care, staff qualifications, and facility maintenance. Additionally, it empowers the Commission to make regulations regarding fees, records, safety, and penalties for offenses.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate formation of trade unions, regulation and improvement of relations between employers and workmen.
repeals: The Punjab Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2010 (II of 2010)
metadata.max_penalty: fine or forfeiture
metadata.one_line: Regulates trade unions, industrial relations, strikes, lock-outs, and establishes labour courts in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation of trade unions and improves relations between employers and workmen in the Punjab. It defines key terms such as collective bargaining agents and illegal strikes/lock-outs, while establishing mechanisms for dispute resolution through Labour Courts and Arbitrators. The Act applies to all persons employed in establishments within the province, excluding specific categories like police, defence services, and certain security staff.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Land Revenue Act 1967.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act 1967 regarding reporting acquisitions of rights and mutation procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Land Revenue Act 1967 to introduce new requirements for reporting the acquisition of land rights. It mandates that persons acquiring rights must report such acquisitions to the Service Centre Official within three months. The Act details the duties of the Service Centre Official in entering particulars into a computerized system and informing parties about mutation processes, as well as the Revenue Officer's role in holding enquiries.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001 regarding elections, council terms, and dissolution procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001 to establish an Election Authority for conducting local government elections. It substitutes several sections of the Ordinance to define the composition and powers of the Election Authority, set the term of office for local governments at four years, and outline procedures for dissolving councils and appointing administrators. The Act also mandates the notification of election results by the new authority.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to transfer election duties to the Election Commission.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to further regulate local government elections. It substitutes sections regarding the conduct of elections by the Election Commission and the notification of results. Additionally, it mandates that elections be held within 365 days and replaces references to the 'Election Authority' with the 'Election Commission' throughout the Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act 1975.
amends: The Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1975
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act 1975 by substituting a clause in section 5 regarding the Secretary to the Government.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Mineral Development Corporation Act 1975. It specifically targets Section 5, Sub-section (1), Clause (ii) of the parent Act. The amendment substitutes the existing text with a reference to the Secretary to the Government, Mines and Minerals Department, or his nominee not below the rank of Deputy Secretary. The Act came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Privatization Board Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Privatization Board: for carrying out a competitive, fair and transparent process for effecting privatization of the properties of the Government and to provide for an expeditious mechanism to resolve disputes relating to privatization and to provide for ancillary matters
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Privatization Board to manage the privatization of government properties in a fair and transparent manner.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Privatization Board as a body corporate to oversee the competitive and transparent privatization of government-owned properties. It defines the composition of the Board, including members from the Provincial Assembly and various government departments, and outlines their functions and powers. The legislation also provides mechanisms for resolving disputes, framing regulations regarding asset valuation and staff recruitment, and grants tax exemptions to the Board.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to formulate the law relating to formation of trade unions, regulation and improvement of relations between employers and workmen.
repeals: Industrial Relations Act, 2008 (IV of 2008)
metadata.max_penalty: fine which may extend to five thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: This Ordinance regulates trade unions, industrial relations, and dispute resolution mechanisms within the Punjab.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Industrial Relations Ordinance, 2010 was promulgated to formulate laws regarding the formation of trade unions and the regulation of relations between employers and workmen in the Punjab. It applies to all persons employed in establishments or industries within the province, excluding specific categories such as police, defence services, and certain security staff. The document establishes mechanisms for collective bargaining, conciliation proceedings, and dispute resolution through Labour Courts and Arbitrators. It also repeals the Industrial Relations Act, 2008, deeming all actions taken under the repealed Act to be valid under this new Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY ACT, 2010

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to reorganize the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority.
repeals: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Ordinance, 1999
establishes: Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority
metadata.one_line: This Act reorganizes the Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority, establishing its functions, composition, and powers.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2010 was enacted to reorganize the existing Authority for better provision of technical education in the Province. It establishes the Authority as a body corporate with specific functions including establishing institutions, regulating courses, providing scholarships, and promoting innovation. The Act defines the composition of the Authority, its powers to make rules and regulations, and includes provisions for appeals, indemnity, and the repeal of the previous 1999 Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958.
amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958 regarding valuation lists and tax recovery intervals.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958 to modify section 7. Specifically, it substitutes clause (a) of subsection (1) in section 7 of the 1958 Act. The amendment addresses procedures for reducing or extending intervals between valuation lists and handling lost or destroyed lists by directing new preparations and tax recovery based on preceding or new lists.

name: PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2009

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958.
amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.one_line: Amends Section 7 of the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act 1958 regarding valuation lists and tax recovery.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to modify provisions related to valuation lists. It grants the authority to reduce or extend intervals between successive valuation lists for rating areas. Additionally, it allows for the cancellation of lost lists and directs the preparation of new ones while ordering the recovery of pending tax based on the last preceding or new list.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ACT, 2010

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to create an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development in the Punjab through public-private partnership projects.
metadata.one_line: Establishes a framework for public-private partnerships in infrastructure projects within the Punjab Province.
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development in the Punjab through public-private partnership (PPP) projects. It establishes institutional arrangements including a PPP Steering Committee, a PPP Cell, and a Risk Management Unit to oversee and coordinate these projects. The Act defines key terms related to PPPs, outlines the applicability of the law to various sectors and government agencies, and provides powers for rule-making and regulation framing to ensure efficient project implementation.

metadata.short_title: The Sasti Roti Authority Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Sasti Roti Authority in the Punjab.
establishes: Board of Management of the Sasti Roti Authority
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in Punjab to provide and distribute subsidized tandoori roti.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in the Province of Punjab for the provision and distribution of sasti roti to deserving people. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to regulate the manufacture, storage, transport, and sale of subsidized flour and sasti roti at fixed rates. It includes provisions for the Board of Management, annual reporting requirements, and the power to make rules and frame regulations to carry out the Act's purposes.

metadata.short_title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to restrict loans and facilities for Directors and their connected persons.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to prohibit the Bank from granting advances, loans, or credit facilities to Directors or their connected persons. It defines 'connected persons' to include family members, entities where the Director holds significant shares or profits, and listed companies where the Director holds over ten percent equity. The amendment also allows the Bank to continue existing facilities granted before a Director's appointment.

metadata.short_title: The Women University Multan Act, 2010
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Women University, Multan.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Women University Multan as a body corporate with perpetual succession.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Women University Multan in the Province of Punjab as a body corporate. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various councils like the Syndicate and Academic Council. The Act outlines the university's functions such as providing education, conducting research, awarding degrees, and maintaining student welfare facilities.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 regarding registration marks and plates.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update provisions on registration marks and number plates. It allows the Government to direct owners of motor vehicles to obtain new registration marks or sets of two number plates within specified periods and procedures. The Act also modifies section 29 regarding the effectiveness of registration certificates across the Province and omits section 30 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish Urban Transport Companies and regulate urban transport services.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the establishment of Urban Transport Companies in notified areas. It grants these companies powers to plan routes, operate services, maintain infrastructure, and fix fares without interference from existing authorities. The Act also defines key terms related to urban transport and empowers the Government to make rules and delegate functions.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to establish Urban Transport Companies and regulate urban transport services.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to facilitate the establishment of Urban Transport Companies in notified areas. It grants these companies powers to plan routes, operate services, maintain infrastructure, and fix fares without interference from transport authorities. The Act also defines key terms related to urban transport and empowers the Government to make rules and delegate functions.

metadata.short_title: The HITEC University of Taxila Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the HITEC University of Taxila.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the HITEC University of Taxila in the private sector within Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the HITEC University of Taxila as a private sector institution located at Taxila Cantt. It defines the composition and functions of key bodies including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various committees responsible for finance, planning, and faculty selection. The University is empowered to offer instruction in sciences, engineering, and social sciences, conduct examinations, award degrees, and manage its own property and staff.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.parent_law: The Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by updating fines for various traffic violations in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update the Twelfth Schedule regarding violations and penalties. It applies to all motor vehicles within the Province of Punjab, including private, commercial, and agricultural vehicles. The document specifies new fine amounts for offenses such as speeding, overloading, driving without a license, and using mobile phones while driving.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to levy tax and alter the rates of tax and duties in the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: on the first day of July 2009
amends: The Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 (I of 1993)

original allotment from a development authority
metadata.one_line: An Act of the Punjab to levy tax, alter tax rates and duties, and amend two existing Acts.
metadata.summary: This Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to levy taxes and alter tax rates and duties within the province. It came into force on July 1, 2009, following assent by the Governor on June 27, 2009. The legislation amends the Stamp Act 1899 regarding the definition of transfer rights for housing authorities and inserts a new clause in the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act 1993 to create a fund for social sector development using surplus assets.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961.
repeals: The Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007 (XXIII of 2007)
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 regarding fish quality and repeals a 2007 amendment.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 to insert provisions for inspecting fish quality before sale or transfer. It requires the Government of the Punjab to prescribe standards that must be met by all fish commercially traded in the province. The Act also repeals the Punjab Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007 and validates actions taken under the repealed ordinance as if done under this new Act.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.max_penalty: fine not less than five hundred rupees and which may extend to one thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to add seatbelt and mobile phone rules and repeal the 2007 Amendment.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce new provisions regarding seatbelts and the use of hand-held mobile telephones while driving. It also modifies existing sections related to vehicle stopping requirements, penalties for offences, and enforcement powers by police or authorized persons. The Act repeals the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES WELARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969.
amends: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969
repeals: The Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2007 (XXII of 2007)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1969 Ordinance regarding government employee welfare funds and repeals the 2007 Amendment Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1969 to redefine 'Government servant' and adjust contribution amounts based on basic scales. It establishes two distinct Provincial Welfare Boards for gazetted and non-gazetted employees and omits specific subsections from the original Ordinance. The Act also repeals the Punjab Government Employees Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance 2007, validating actions taken under the repealed Ordinance as if done under this new Act.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992.
repeals: The Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992 by updating definitions and repealing a 2007 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Katchi Abadis Act, 1992 to update terminology regarding Governmental Agencies and Development Authorities. It establishes Implementation Committees for districts with Katchi Abadis and introduces provisions for surcharges on misappropriation of funds. The Act also repeals the Punjab Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007, validating actions taken under that Ordinance.

name: PUNJAB GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND ACT 2009

metadata.short_title: The Punjab General Provident Investment Fund Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund to generate revenues for the discharge of the General Provident Fund liabilities of the Government and to make provisions for ancillary matters.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Punjab
establishes: General Provident Investment Fund Management Committee
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund to generate revenue for GPFL liabilities and outlines its management.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab General Provident Investment Fund to generate revenues for discharging the liabilities of the General Provident Fund. The Government creates a Reserve Fund, while the Management Committee is empowered to formulate investment policies and manage the Fund's assets. The Act defines key terms, sets limitations on investments, outlines conflict of interest rules for committee members, and mandates the submission of annual reports to the Provincial Assembly.

name: PUNJAB MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 (XXXI of 1960).
amends: The Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 (XXXI of 1960)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1960 Ordinance regarding detention reviews, district coordination officers, and prohibition of publications.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 to establish a Review Board for detaining persons exceeding three months. It substitutes various sections to replace the District Magistrate with the District Coordination Officer and introduces powers to prohibit newspapers or other publications prejudicial to public order. The Act also outlines procedures for reviewing detention cases and seizing prohibited publications.

name: PUNJAB PROHIBITION OF KITE FLYING (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Prohibition of Dangerous Kite Flying Activities Ordinance, 2001.
amends: The Punjab Prohibition of Dangerous Kite Flying Activities Ordinance, 2001
repeals: The Punjab Prohibition of Kite Flying (Amendment) Ordinance, 2007
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years or to fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees or to both
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2001 Ordinance to prohibit kite flying with dangerous materials and regulates manufacturing and sales.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Prohibition of Dangerous Kite Flying Activities Ordinance, 2001 by changing its title and substituting specific sections. It redefines 'kite flying' to include any flight endangering life or property using metallic wires or sharp materials. The Act prohibits manufacturing, selling, or abetting kite flying with such dangerous materials while allowing temporary permissions for safe kites during the spring season. It also establishes requirements for trader registration and creates offences with penalties up to three years imprisonment or a fine of 100,000 rupees.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Procurement Regulatory Authority in the Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority Ordinance, 2007 (XIX of 2007)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate public sector procurement in the province.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, and works in the public sector within the Punjab. It defines key terms such as 'corrupt and fraudulent practices' and outlines the functions of the Authority, including monitoring compliance and making regulations. The Act also empowers the Board of Management to delegate certain powers while retaining specific authorities like approving audited accounts.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Rented Premises Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to regulate the relationship of landlord and tenant in respect of rented premises.
repeals: The Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Ordinance, 1959 (VI of 1959)
The Punjab Rented Premises Ordinance, 2007 (XXI of 2007)
metadata.one_line: Regulates landlord-tenant relationships, mandates tenancy agreements, and establishes Rent Tribunals in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the relationship between landlords and tenants regarding rented premises in Punjab. It mandates written tenancy agreements registered with a Rent Registrar and defines key terms like 'pagri' and 'premises'. The Act establishes Rent Tribunals to handle disputes expeditiously and repeals previous rent restriction laws.

name: PUNJAB PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOR INFRASTRUCTURE ORDINANCE, 2009

metadata.short_title: Punjab Public-Private Partnership for Infrastructure Ordinance, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to create an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development in the Punjab through public-private partnership projects.
metadata.one_line: Creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure projects in Punjab via PPP.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a framework to mobilize private sector resources for financing, construction, and operation of infrastructure projects in the Punjab. It creates institutional arrangements including a Steering Committee and specific cells to oversee these projects. The law defines various contractual models such as BOT, BOOT, and management contracts to facilitate public-private partnerships.

metadata.short_title: The Societies Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860.
metadata.parent_law: The Societies Registration Act, 1860
metadata.one_line: Amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by adding definitions and provisions for amalgamation, division, and rule-making.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to introduce new definitions and procedures. It inserts a section defining terms like 'Government' and 'Registrar' within the context of Punjab. The text also substitutes Section 12 to regulate amalgamation and division of societies, requiring specific voting thresholds and Registrar approval. Additionally, it grants the Government power to make rules for carrying out the Act's purposes.

metadata.short_title: The Sasti Roti Authority Ordinance, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of the Sasti Roti Authority in the Punjab.
establishes: Board of Management of the Sasti Roti Authority
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in Punjab to provide and distribute subsidized tandoori roti.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sasti Roti Authority in the Province of Punjab to ensure the provision and fair distribution of subsidized tandoori roti to deserving people. The Authority is a body corporate with powers to regulate manufacture, storage, transport, and pricing of sasti roti, as well as to issue licenses and fix rates. It includes provisions for the Board of Management, annual reporting to the Provincial Assembly, and the power to make rules and regulations for its administration.

name: UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT 2009

metadata.short_title: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002.
amends: The University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Amends the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 regarding Vice Chancellor appointment procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Health Sciences, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to regulate the appointment process for the Vice Chancellor. It establishes a Search Committee consisting of at least three persons, including one from the medical profession, to recommend candidates to the Chief Minister. The amendment specifies that the Chancellor appoints the Vice Chancellor on the advice of the Chief Minister based on the Search Committee's recommendations, requiring candidates to be qualified as professors in medical institutions.

name: ALI INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.short_title: The Ali Institute of Education Lahore Ordinance, 2008
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the establishment of the Ali Institute of Education Lahore.
establishes: Ali Institute of Education Lahore Fund
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Ali Institute of Education Lahore as a private sector body corporate in Lahore.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Ali Institute of Education Lahore as a private sector body corporate located in Lahore. It defines the roles of the Chancellor, Board of Governors, and various officers while outlining the Institute's functions such as providing teacher education degrees, conducting research, and managing student welfare. The document also sets up an institute fund and grants the Board powers to make regulations and statutes for administration.

metadata.short_title: The Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to provide for the amendment of the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by omitting section 7 via a Governor's Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to omit section 7. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary. The Ordinance came into force at once upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The King Edward Medical University (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005.
amends: The King Edward Medical University Act, 2005
metadata.one_line: Amends the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005 regarding Vice Chancellor appointment procedures.
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the King Edward Medical University Act, 2005 to modify the process for appointing a Vice Chancellor. It stipulates that the Vice Chancellor is appointed by the Chancellor on the recommendation of the Chief Minister for a term not exceeding four years. The amendment introduces a requirement for a Search Committee to advertise the post and interview candidates before making recommendations to the Chief Minister. The Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.short_title: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation (Repeal) Act, 2008
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Nazaria--Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997 (XII of 1997).
repeals: The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997 (XII of 1997)
The Nazaria-i-Pakistan Foundation (Repeal) Ordinance, 2008

It prohibits police officials from interfering with treatment unless necessary for investigation with hospital permission and forbids taking injured persons to police stations before they are stabilized. The legislation also protects the identity of individuals who bring injured persons to hospitals and establishes penalties for violations.

metadata.short_title: The New Murree Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004.
amends: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.one_line: Amends the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004 by adding a Tourism and Resort Member to its composition.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004 (Act I of 2004) to alter the composition of its membership. Specifically, it inserts a new clause designating the Secretary, Tourism and Resort Development Department as an ex-officio member. Additionally, it modifies section 4 by substituting 'and' for a comma in clause (f) and omitting the reference to '& Tourism'. The Act came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 regarding insurance security for compensation.
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 49 of the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965. It requires applicants to furnish specific insurance security issued by a registered company. This security must be approved by the Chairman of the Regional Transport Authority. The requirement covers payment of any compensation under section 67.

metadata.short_title: The New Murree Development Authority Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for establishment of the New. Murree Development Authority.
metadata.territorial_extent: such areas as may be notified by the Government from time to time
metadata.one_line: Establishes the New Murree Development Authority for planning and managing a new township near Murree in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the New Murree Development Authority to plan, develop, and manage a new township near Murree. The Authority is a corporate body with perpetual succession, comprising ex-officio members from various provincial departments and non-official members appointed by the Government. It possesses powers to prepare master plans, enforce building regulations, acquire property, and implement schemes for environmental improvements and infrastructure development within notified areas.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the restructuring of the Punjab Education Foundation.
repeals: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 1991
metadata.one_line: This Act restructures the Punjab Education Foundation to promote private sector involvement in education.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Education Foundation Act, 2004 was enacted to restructure the Punjab Education Foundation for the promotion of education. It establishes a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its functions, including providing financial assistance, incentives, and technical support to educational institutions. The Act creates a Board of Directors comprising government nominees and private sector representatives to manage the foundation's affairs.

name: PUNJAB DESTITUTE AND NEGLECTED CHILDREN ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Destitute and Neglected Children Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to consolidate the law for the rescue, protective custody, care and rehabilitation of destitute and neglected children in the Province of the Punjab.
metadata.commencement: at once but shall take effect in such areas and from such date as the Government may, by notification, specify
repeals: The Punjab Children Ordinance, 1983 (XXII of 1983)
The Punjab Youthful Offenders Ordinance, 1983 (XXIII of 1983)
The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976 (XVI of 1976)
establishes: Destitute and Neglected Children's Welfare Fund
metadata.administering_body: Government of the Punjab in the Home Department
metadata.one_line: Consolidates laws for rescuing, protecting, caring for, and rehabilitating destitute and neglected children in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates existing laws regarding the rescue, protective custody, care, and rehabilitation of destitute and neglected children in the Province of the Punjab. It establishes a Child Protection and Welfare Bureau with a Board of Governors to oversee these functions. The Act defines specific categories of neglected children, including those begging, living in brothels, or beyond parental control, and sets up mechanisms for their protection and welfare.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to enhance, reduce and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Province of the Punjab.
amends: The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958)
metadata.one_line: Amends various provincial acts to rationalize taxes and fees on property, vehicles, and professional services in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act of 1899, the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act of 1958, and the Punjab Finance Act of 1977. It primarily aims to rationalize stamp duties by substituting fixed fees with a percentage-based rate (Two percent) for various instruments like conveyances and bonds. Additionally, it updates fee schedules for vehicle registration, hire purchase agreements, and professional services such as medical consultants and tobacco vendors.

name: PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a Housing Foundation for Government servants.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole Province of the Punjab
metadata.one_line: Establishes a foundation to provide housing facilities for Government servants in the Province of the Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation to provide residential units for government servants and their families. The Foundation is a body corporate with powers to acquire land, develop residential colonies, and manage funds. It includes a Board of Directors comprising senior officials and civil servants to oversee operations, ensure housing allocation based on seniority, and manage financial accounts.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation.
metadata.commencement: at once but shall take effect on such date as may be notified by the Government in the official Gazette
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation to provide non-profit housing plots for journalists in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Journalists Housing Foundation to introduce schemes for the allotment of plots for the construction of houses on a non-profit basis. The Foundation is established as a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal, empowered to acquire land, hold property, and manage funds. It consists of a Board of Directors comprising government officials, nominated members, and representatives from press clubs, who exercise powers necessary to carry out the Act's purposes.

name: PUNJAB INSTITUTE OF LANGUAGE, ART AND CULTURE ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture.
repeals: Punjabi Language Act
establishes: Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture to promote Punjabi language, art, and culture.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Punjab Institute of Language, Art and Culture as a body corporate with perpetual succession. The Institute is responsible for promoting and developing the Punjabi language, art, and culture through research, library establishment, and cultural projects. It advises the Government on policy matters and facilitates collaboration with local and international institutions to preserve folk arts and promote national unity.

name: PUNJAB PRIVATE SECURITY COMPANIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002.
amends: The Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2002 Ordinance to prohibit cash-in-transit without a No Objection Certificate.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Private Security Companies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2002. It adds a new section 5-A that prohibits private security companies from undertaking the transit of cash or valuable articles unless a No Objection Certificate is issued by the Licensing Authority. The Act came into force immediately upon its publication.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970.
metadata.parent_law: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
amends: The Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970 regarding member nomination and agency functions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Social Services Board Ordinance, 1970 to update provisions on the nomination of board members. It specifies requirements for women representation and expertise in fields like education and health. Additionally, it modifies clauses related to collaboration with voluntary social welfare agencies and their functions.

metadata.short_title: The University of Education, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002.
amends: The University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to define the Pro-Chancellor and adjust Chancellor functions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Education, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 to formally define the role of the Pro-Chancellor. It designates the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and outlines their duties delegated by the Chancellor. The Act also modifies section 19 of the Ordinance to include three members of the Provincial Assembly nominated by the Speaker.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, TAXILA (AMENDMENT) ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994.
amends: The University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994
metadata.one_line: Amends the UET Taxila Act 1994 to align Chancellor's functions with the Governor under Article 105.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila Act, 1994 by adding a new subsection to Section 9. The amendment stipulates that the Chancellor must act and be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province under Article 105 of the Constitution of Pakistan. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent on February 23, 2004.

metadata.short_title: The Superior College, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Superior College, Lahore.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Superior College, Lahore as a private sector institute in Punjab with specific governance and academic functions.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Superior College, Lahore as a body corporate in the private sector located in Lahore. It defines the composition and powers of the Board of Governors, appoints the Patron as the Governor of the Punjab, and outlines the college's functions including instruction, research, and degree conferment. The Act also sets up a College Fund and provides mechanisms for inspection, regulation making, and removal of difficulties.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, LAHORE ACT 2004

metadata.short_title: The University of Management and Technology, Lahore Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University of Management and Technology, Lahore.
repeals: The Institute of Management and Technology, Lahore Ordinance, 2002 (XVIII of 2002)
establishes: University of Management and Technology, Lahore
Institute of Leadership and Management (ILM) Trust
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Management and Technology, Lahore as a private sector body corporate in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Management and Technology, Lahore as a private sector institution located in Lahore. It defines the university's functions, including providing instruction in management sciences, information technology, and other branches of learning, as well as conducting research and awarding degrees. The Act creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, appoints the Governor of the Punjab as Patron, and sets up governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council to manage affairs.

metadata.short_title: The University of Sargodha (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002.
metadata.one_line: Amends the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002 to define the Pro-Chancellor and add Provincial Assembly members.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002 to clarify the role of the Pro-Chancellor. It designates the Minister for Education as the Pro-Chancellor and assigns duties delegated by the Chancellor. The Act also adds three members from the Provincial Assembly to the university's governing body and ensures the Chancellor acts under Article 105 of the Constitution.

metadata.short_title: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act 1989.
repeals: The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.one_line: Amends the Bank of Punjab Act 1989 by substituting 'Government' for 'Governor' in section 10 and repeals a 2002 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 by replacing the word 'Governor' with 'Government' in subsection (2) of section 10. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and assented to by the Governor on February 8, 2003. The Act also repeals the Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997.
amends: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 regarding High Court judges and tenure.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 to allow sitting High Court judges working as Ombudsmen to be called back before their tenure expires. It also modifies eligibility criteria by excluding sitting High Court judges from certain provisions and changes numerical limits in the original Act. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and received assent from the Governor on February 8, 2003.

name: INSTITUTE OF SOUTH ASIA, LAHORE ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Institute of South Asia, Lahore Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Institute of South Asia, Lahore and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
repeals: The Institute of South Asia, Lahore, Ordinance, 2003 (V of 2003)
subjects: functions and powers of the Institute
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Institute of South Asia, Lahore as a body corporate in Punjab with specific functions and governance structures.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of South Asia, Lahore as a body corporate with perpetual succession to provide instruction, training, and research. The Institute is governed by a Board of Governors comprising representatives from the company, Higher Education Commission, universities, and the government. It empowers the Board to make regulations, appoint staff, and manage the Institute Fund while operating within the jurisdiction of the Punjab.

metadata.short_title: The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002.
repeals: The Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.one_line: Amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by substituting 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' and repeals two other Ordinances.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002 by replacing references to the 'Governor' with the 'Chief Minister' in specific sections. It applies to the Province of Punjab and comes into force immediately upon enactment. Additionally, the Act repeals the Lahore Arts Council (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002, and the Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972.
amends: The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1972 Privileges Act to regulate official vehicle plates for Assembly members.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 by adding a new section regarding official vehicle plates. It grants members the right to display an official plate issued at government expense on their specific vehicle. The Act outlines rules for using these plates only when the member is present and requires their surrender upon ceasing office or if damaged.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act 1997.
amends: The Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act 1997 regarding tax liability on land transfers to spouses and minor heirs.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1997 to address tax liabilities arising from land transfers. It stipulates that persons transferring land to their wives or heirs under eighteen years of age remain liable for tax as if the transfer did not occur, until the heir reaches adulthood. Additionally, it substitutes specific entries in the First Schedule of the parent Act regarding tax rates based on acreage.

metadata.short_title: The University of Gujrat Act, 2004
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University of Gujrat.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Gujrat and provides for its constitution, powers, and affiliated institutions.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Gujrat by reconstituting existing government colleges in Gujrat. It defines the university's structure, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Academic Council. The legislation grants the university powers to frame statutes, conduct examinations, confer degrees, and manage affiliated institutions while outlining committees for discipline and affiliation.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Finance Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to enhance, reduce and rationalize certain taxes, fees and duties in the Province of the Punjab.
amends: The Punjab Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 (X of 1958)
The Punjab Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 (XXXII of 1958)
metadata.one_line: Amends various Punjab Acts to enhance, reduce and rationalize taxes, fees and duties.
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws in the Province of the Punjab to enhance, reduce, and rationalize certain taxes, fees, and duties. It specifically updates the Stamp Act, Entertainments Duty Act, Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, and previous Finance Acts with new figures and clauses. The amendments come into force on the first day of July 2003.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Juvenile Smoking (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959.
metadata.commencement: at once except section 3 which shall come into effect on a date to be notified by Government
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment which may extend to six months or fine which may extend to five thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1959 Ordinance to raise the smoking age limit and add penalties for selling tobacco to juveniles.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959 to further regulate the sale of tobacco to minors. It raises the prohibited age from sixteen to eighteen years and expands the definition of educational institutions. The Act also introduces new sections regarding non-cognizable offences and mandates wide publicity before enforcement.

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act further to amend the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001.
metadata.commencement: at once and deemed to have taken effect from 31st December 2002
repeals: The Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance 2001 and repeals a previous amendment ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting specific dates in section 24. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February 8, 2003, and received assent from the Governor on February 10, 2003. The Act comes into force immediately but is deemed effective from December 31, 2002. Additionally, it repeals the Punjab Local Government (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.

name: PUNJAB MARRIAGE FUNCTIONS (PROHIBITION OF OSTENTATIOUS DISPLAYS AND WASTEFUL EXPENSES) ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Marriage Functions (Prohibition of Ostentatious Displays and Wasteful Expenses) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to prohibit wasteful expenses on marriages and ceremonies related thereto.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of the Punjab
establishes: Committee for each Union, Tehsil or Town
metadata.max_penalty: fine not less than one hundred thousand rupees and not more than three hundred thousand rupees
metadata.one_line: Prohibits wasteful expenses, ostentatious displays, fireworks, and excessive food service at marriage ceremonies in Punjab.
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits wasteful expenses on marriages and related ceremonies within the Province of Punjab. It bans decorating public places with lights, exploding crackers or fireworks, displaying dowry publicly, and serving full meals except soup or drinks to more than three hundred invitees at a Walima ceremony. The law establishes committees for each Union, Tehsil, or Town to enforce these provisions and prescribes fines for contravention.

name: PUNJAB OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
amends: The Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997
metadata.one_line: Amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 regarding judge tenure and appointment procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Office of the Ombudsman Act, 1997 to modify provisions concerning High Court judges serving as Ombudsmen. It substitutes specific wording in Section 3 to allow any other person besides a sitting judge to be appointed. Additionally, it changes the tenure limit from three to four years and adds a proviso allowing a sitting judge Ombudsman to be recalled before their tenure expires. The Act also inserts restrictions regarding non-sitting judges and omits references to 'or the Province' in Section 5.

name: PUNJAB PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES OF MEMBERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) (Amendment) Act, 2003

amends: The Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974
key_definitions: member (includes a member of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, the Speaker, the Deputy Speaker and a Minister)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1974 Act to define 'member' in section 5-A to include the Speaker, Deputy Speaker, and Ministers.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Provincial Assembly (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges of Members) Act, 1974. Specifically, it adds an explanation to section 5-A of the 1974 Act. The amendment clarifies that the term 'member' includes not only regular members but also the Speaker, the Deputy Speaker, and a Minister.

name: PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment and management of Medical and Health Institutions in the Punjab.
repeals: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Ordinance, 2002 (VIII of 2002)
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes and regulates Medical and Health Institutions in Punjab through a Board of Management.
metadata.summary: The Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 provides for the establishment and efficient management of medical and health institutions within the province. It creates a Board of Management to oversee these institutions, which are defined as hospitals, laboratories, or medical facilities. The Act outlines the composition of the Board, including government representatives and non-official members, and grants the institution status as a body corporate with perpetual succession.

name: PUNJAB REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2003

amends: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
repeals: The Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
subjects: substitution of Governor with Chief Minister
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2000 Ordinance by substituting 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' and repeals the 2002 Amendment Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 to replace references to the Governor with the Chief Minister. It specifically substitutes 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' in sections 2, 16, and 9 of the 2000 Ordinance, and deletes specific phrases referencing the Governor in sections 5 and 9. Additionally, the Act repeals the Punjab Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

name: PUNJAB SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OF CHILDREN HOMES (AMENDMENT) ACT 2003

metadata.short_title: The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976.
amends: The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1976 Act to require at least four women members in relevant sections.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on October 28, 2003, and assented to by the Governor on November 1, 2003. The amendment specifically inserts a requirement for at least four women members in Section 4 of the parent Act.

name: THE BANK OF PUNJAB (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2002

metadata.long_title: An Ordinance further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 to replace the word 'Governor' with 'Government' in subsection (2) of section 10. It was promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session. The Ordinance came into force immediately upon publication.

name: THE LAHORE ARTS COUNCIL (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2003

metadata.short_title: The Lahore Arts Council (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.long_title: An Ordinance to amend the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2002.
